package server

import (
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/agent"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/cortex"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/engines"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/llm"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/relay"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/swarm"
)

type Deps struct {
	Agent    *agent.Agent
	Store    cortex.Store
	Sessions cortex.SessionStore
	Auth     *cortex.AuthStore
	Usage    *llm.Tracker
	Addr     string
}

func Serve(d Deps) error {
	addr := d.Addr
	if addr == "" {
		addr = "127.0.0.1:8420"
	}
	// F16 remainder: the default bind is loopback, but an explicitly configured
	// non-loopback address with no auth store (file backend) would expose an
	// unauthenticated server to the network. Refuse to start unless the
	// operator explicitly accepts that with MIMIR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=1.
	if d.Auth == nil && os.Getenv("MIMIR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED") != "1" && !isLoopbackAddr(addr) {
		// Trust-boundary record (FIX 6): a refused unauthenticated bind is a
		// security event the operator should be able to find in the logs.
		slog.Default().Error("refusing unauthenticated non-loopback bind",
			"addr", addr, "opt_in_env", "MIMIR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED")
		return fmt.Errorf("refusing to serve on non-loopback address %s without authentication: use the surreal backend for auth, or set MIMIR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=1 to accept the risk", addr)
	}
	return http.ListenAndServe(addr, Handler(d.Agent, d.Store, d.Sessions, d.Auth, d.Usage))
}

// isLoopbackAddr reports whether a listen address binds only the loopback
// interface. An empty host binds all interfaces and is not loopback.
func isLoopbackAddr(addr string) bool {
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(host, "localhost") {
		return true
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(host)
	return ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback()
}

func Handler(ag *agent.Agent, st cortex.Store, sessions cortex.SessionStore, auth *cortex.AuthStore, usage *llm.Tracker) http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	relayMgr := relay.NewManager()

	// Per-session permission modes (N2): a mode set for one session must never
	// mutate the shared agent's mode for every other user. /chat resolves the
	// effective mode per request: an explicit request mode wins, then the
	// session's stored mode, then the agent default.
	var modeMu sync.Mutex
	sessionModes := map[string]string{}
	setSessionMode := func(sessionID, mode string) {
		modeMu.Lock()
		defer modeMu.Unlock()
		sessionModes[sessionID] = mode
	}
	sessionMode := func(sessionID string) string {
		modeMu.Lock()
		defer modeMu.Unlock()
		return sessionModes[sessionID]
	}
	requestMode := func(explicit, sessionID string) string {
		if m, ok := parseMode(explicit); ok {
			return m
		}
		if sessionID != "" {
			return sessionMode(sessionID)
		}
		return ""
	}

	// checkMobileSession enforces the F12 ownership rule for the mobile
	// endpoints (FIX 1): the target session must exist and belong to the
	// caller, using the same caller/owner test as the session item routes
	// and /chat. In local mode the caller is "local" and passes; with no
	// session store wired there is nothing to check against. On rejection
	// it writes the response plus a trust-boundary log record (FIX 6) and
	// returns false.
	checkMobileSession := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, action, sessionID string) bool {
		log := slog.Default()
		if sessions == nil {
			return true
		}
		sess, err := sessions.GetSession(r.Context(), sessionID)
		if err != nil {
			log.Warn("mobile request rejected: unknown session",
				"action", action, "session_id", sessionID, "caller", userIDFromContext(r.Context()))
			http.Error(w, "forbidden: session does not belong to you", http.StatusForbidden)
			return false
		}
		callerID := userIDFromContext(r.Context())
		if callerID != "" && callerID != "local" && sess.UserID != "" && sess.UserID != callerID {
			log.Warn("mobile request rejected: foreign session",
				"action", action, "session_id", sessionID, "caller", callerID)
			http.Error(w, "forbidden: session does not belong to you", http.StatusForbidden)
			return false
		}
		return true
	}

	// Public
	mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		writeJSON(w, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
	})

	// Public E2EE Pair & Mobile endpoints
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/pair", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		sess, err := relayMgr.CreateSession(r.Host)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		asciiQR, _ := sess.GenerateQRCodeASCII()
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{
			"session":  sess,
			"pair_uri": sess.PairURI(),
			"ascii_qr": asciiQR,
		})
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/pair/complete", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			http.Error(w, "POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		var req struct {
			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
			// PairingToken is the session nonce from the QR code / pair URI:
			// it proves the phone actually scanned the code, so a caller that
			// merely learned the session ID cannot hijack the pairing.
			PairingToken string `json:"pairing_token"`
			ClientPub    string `json:"client_pubkey"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		sess, ok := relayMgr.GetSession(req.SessionID)
		if !ok {
			slog.Default().Warn("pairing complete rejected: unknown session", "session_id", req.SessionID)
			http.Error(w, "session not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err := sess.CompletePairing(req.PairingToken, req.ClientPub); err != nil {
			slog.Default().Warn("pairing complete failed", "session_id", req.SessionID, "err", err)
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		slog.Default().Info("pairing complete", "session_id", sess.ID)
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"status": "paired", "session_id": sess.ID})
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/mobile/stream", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		sessID := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
		sess, ok := relayMgr.GetSession(sessID)
		if !ok {
			http.Error(w, "session not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		sess.StreamHandler()(w, r)
	})
	// The mobile steer and mode endpoints sit behind the same auth
	// middleware as /chat (FIX 1): steer injects text into the agent's next
	// run and mode can arm bypass for a session, so neither may be public.
	// Each also binds to the caller's own session via checkMobileSession.
	mux.Handle("/api/mobile/steer", authMiddleware(auth)(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			http.Error(w, "POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		var req struct {
			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
			Message   string `json:"message"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		if req.SessionID == "" {
			slog.Default().Warn("mobile steer rejected: missing session", "caller", userIDFromContext(r.Context()))
			http.Error(w, "session_id is required: steers are bound to a session", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		if !checkMobileSession(w, r, "steer", req.SessionID) {
			return
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Message) == "" {
			slog.Default().Warn("mobile steer rejected: empty message",
				"session_id", req.SessionID, "caller", userIDFromContext(r.Context()))
			http.Error(w, "message is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		// The steer is queued under the caller's own session (validated
		// above); delivery is bound to that session inside the agent.
		// Steer reports whether the instruction was actually queued: a
		// full queue is a per-session rate limit (429, not 503: the
		// service is up, and the limit clears as soon as the session's
		// next run drains the queue). The acceptance log line is written
		// only on real acceptance (FIX 2).
		if !ag.Steer(req.SessionID, req.Message) {
			slog.Default().Warn("mobile steer rejected: session steer queue full",
				"session_id", req.SessionID, "caller", userIDFromContext(r.Context()))
			writeErrorJSON(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests, "steer queue full for this session: run the session to consume queued steering, then retry")
			return
		}
		// FIX 6: log the acceptance with the message LENGTH only; steer
		// text is user content and never goes in the logs.
		slog.Default().Info("mobile steer accepted",
			"session_id", req.SessionID, "caller", userIDFromContext(r.Context()), "message_len", len(req.Message))
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"status": "steered", "message": req.Message})
	})))
	mux.Handle("/api/mobile/mode", authMiddleware(auth)(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			http.Error(w, "POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		var req struct {
			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
			Mode      string `json:"mode"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		mode, ok := parseMode(req.Mode)
		if !ok {
			http.Error(w, "invalid mode: ro, edit, or bypass required", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		if req.SessionID == "" {
			// A mode without a session would have to mutate the shared agent,
			// which is exactly the N2 leak; modes are per-session state now.
			http.Error(w, "session_id is required: modes are stored per session", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		if !checkMobileSession(w, r, "mode", req.SessionID) {
			return
		}
		setSessionMode(req.SessionID, mode)
		slog.Default().Info("mobile mode set",
			"session_id", req.SessionID, "caller", userIDFromContext(r.Context()), "mode", mode)
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"status": "ok", "mode": mode, "session_id": req.SessionID})
	})))
	// /api/status discloses provider, model, mode, and SDLC phase (N10): when
	// an auth store is configured it requires authentication like every other
	// API route; in local mode the middleware passes through (loopback-only
	// bind per the F16 fix), so local behavior is unchanged.
	mux.Handle("/api/status", authMiddleware(auth)(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		pid, model, local := ag.ModelInfo()
		sdlcMgr := ag.SDLC()
		currPhase := ""
		if sdlcMgr != nil {
			currPhase = sdlcMgr.CurrentPhase().Title
		}
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{
			"status":      "ok",
			"provider":    pid,
			"model":       model,
			"local":       local,
			"mode":        ag.Mode(),
			"effort":      ag.Effort(),
			"smol":        ag.SmolMode(),
			"sdlc_phase":  currPhase,
			"attribution": engines.AttributionNotice,
		})
	})))
	mux.HandleFunc("/auth/send-code", sendCodeHandler(auth))
	mux.HandleFunc("/auth/verify-code", verifyCodeHandler(auth))

	// Landing page
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path != "/" {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = w.Write(landingHTML)
	})

	// Auth page
	mux.HandleFunc("/auth", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = w.Write(authHTML)
	})

	// App page (protected client-side via token redirect)
	mux.HandleFunc("/app", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = w.Write(uiHTML)
	})

	// Protected API routes (built as a sub-mux then wrapped with auth)
	api := http.NewServeMux()
	api.HandleFunc("/sessions", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		userID := userIDFromContext(r.Context())
		switch r.Method {
		case http.MethodGet:
			list, err := sessions.ListSessions(r.Context(), userID)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
			writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"sessions": list})
		case http.MethodPost:
			var req struct {
				Title string `json:"title"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			if req.Title == "" {
				req.Title = "New Conversation"
			}
			sess, err := sessions.CreateSession(r.Context(), req.Title, userID)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
			writeJSON(w, sess)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "GET or POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		}
	})
	api.HandleFunc("/sessions/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		id := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/sessions/")
		if id == "" {
			http.Error(w, "session id required", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		callerID := userIDFromContext(r.Context())
		sess, err := sessions.GetSession(r.Context(), id)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		// IDOR ownership check (F12): user can only access their own sessions unless local mode
		if callerID != "" && callerID != "local" && sess.UserID != "" && sess.UserID != callerID {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden: session does not belong to you", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}

		switch r.Method {
		case http.MethodGet:
			writeJSON(w, sess)
		case http.MethodDelete:
			if err := sessions.DeleteSession(r.Context(), id); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
			writeJSON(w, map[string]string{"status": "deleted"})
		case http.MethodPut:
			var req struct {
				Title string `json:"title"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			if err := sessions.UpdateTitle(r.Context(), id, req.Title); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
			writeJSON(w, map[string]string{"status": "updated"})
		default:
			http.Error(w, "GET, PUT, or DELETE only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		}
	})
	api.HandleFunc("/auth/me", meHandler(auth))
	api.HandleFunc("/memory", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		neurons := st.All()
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"count": len(neurons), "neurons": neurons})
	})
	api.HandleFunc("/usage", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		models := []llm.ModelUsage{}
		total := 0
		if usage != nil {
			if snap := usage.Snapshot(); snap != nil {
				models = snap
			}
			total = usage.TotalTokens()
		}
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"total_tokens": total, "models": models})
	})
	api.HandleFunc("/chat", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			http.Error(w, "POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		var req struct {
			Prompt    string `json:"prompt"`
			Mode      string `json:"mode"`
			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		var history []llm.Message
		if req.SessionID != "" {
			callerID := userIDFromContext(r.Context())
			sess, err := sessions.GetSession(r.Context(), req.SessionID)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "session not found", http.StatusNotFound)
				return
			}
			if callerID != "" && callerID != "local" && sess.UserID != "" && sess.UserID != callerID {
				http.Error(w, "forbidden: session does not belong to you", http.StatusForbidden)
				return
			}
			if len(sess.Messages) > 0 {
				for _, m := range sess.Messages {
					history = append(history, llm.Message{Role: m.Role, Content: m.Content})
				}
			}
			if err := sessions.AppendMessage(r.Context(), req.SessionID, cortex.Message{
				Role: "user", Content: req.Prompt,
			}); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
		}
		// The run is bound to the request's session so steering queued for
		// this session is delivered only here, never into another run.
		res, err := ag.RunFullWithMode(agent.WithSessionID(r.Context(), req.SessionID), requestMode(req.Mode, req.SessionID), strings.TrimSpace(req.Prompt), history)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		if req.SessionID != "" && res.Reply != "" {
			if err := sessions.AppendMessage(r.Context(), req.SessionID, cortex.Message{
				Role: "assistant", Content: res.Reply,
			}); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
		}
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{
			"reply":    res.Reply,
			"trace":    res.Trace,
			"recalled": res.Recalled,
		})
	})
	api.HandleFunc("/chat/stream", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			http.Error(w, "POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		var req struct {
			Prompt    string `json:"prompt"`
			Mode      string `json:"mode"`
			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
		if !ok {
			http.Error(w, "streaming unsupported", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
		w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
		var history []llm.Message
		if req.SessionID != "" {
			callerID := userIDFromContext(r.Context())
			sess, err := sessions.GetSession(r.Context(), req.SessionID)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "session not found", http.StatusNotFound)
				return
			}
			if callerID != "" && callerID != "local" && sess.UserID != "" && sess.UserID != callerID {
				http.Error(w, "forbidden: session does not belong to you", http.StatusForbidden)
				return
			}
			if len(sess.Messages) > 0 {
				for _, m := range sess.Messages {
					history = append(history, llm.Message{Role: m.Role, Content: m.Content})
				}
			}
			_ = sessions.AppendMessage(r.Context(), req.SessionID, cortex.Message{
				Role:    "user",
				Content: req.Prompt,
			})
		}
		var assistantReply string
		err := ag.RunStreamWithMode(agent.WithSessionID(r.Context(), req.SessionID), requestMode(req.Mode, req.SessionID), strings.TrimSpace(req.Prompt), history, func(e agent.Event) {
			b, err := json.Marshal(e)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte("data: " + string(b) + "\n\n"))
			flusher.Flush()
			if e.Type == agent.EventDone {
				assistantReply = e.Reply
			}
		})
		if req.SessionID != "" && assistantReply != "" {
			_ = sessions.AppendMessage(r.Context(), req.SessionID, cortex.Message{
				Role:    "assistant",
				Content: assistantReply,
			})
		}
		if err != nil {
			// Marshal the error frame (FIX 3): the previous hand-rolled %q
			// frame emitted \xNN escapes for control bytes, which are not
			// valid JSON, so strict SSE consumers could not parse it.
			frame, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"type": "error", "err": err.Error()})
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte("data: " + string(frame) + "\n\n"))
			flusher.Flush()
		}
	})

	api.HandleFunc("/engines", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		m, err := engines.LoadManifest(".")
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		writeJSON(w, m)
	})
	api.HandleFunc("/swarm", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		f := swarm.NewFactory(swarm.FactoryConfig{
			RootDir:      ".",
			MaxWorkers:   4,
			TargetBranch: "main",
		})
		switch r.Method {
		case http.MethodGet:
			writeJSON(w, map[string]any{
				"tasks": f.ListTasks(),
			})
		case http.MethodPost:
			var req struct {
				Title       string `json:"title"`
				Description string `json:"description"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			t, err := f.Submit(req.Title, req.Description)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			writeJSON(w, t)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "GET or POST only", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		}
	})

	// Wrap the api mux with auth middleware and register on main mux
	mux.Handle("/sessions", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/sessions/", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/auth/me", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/memory", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/usage", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/chat", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/chat/stream", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/engines", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/swarm", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/api/engines", authMiddleware(auth)(api))
	mux.Handle("/api/swarm", authMiddleware(auth)(api))

	return mux
}

// parseMode validates a client-supplied permission mode string and returns
// its canonical form.
func parseMode(s string) (string, bool) {
	switch m := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)); m {
	case agent.ModeReadOnly, agent.ModeEdit, agent.ModeBypass:
		return m, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, v any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
}

// TestServerChatStream proves POST /chat/stream speaks SSE: token deltas arrive as
// separate events and a done event carries the full reply.
func TestServerChatStream(t *testing.T) {
	store, err := cortex.NewMemoryStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "cortex.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store: %v", err)
	}
	ag := agent.New(agent.Config{Provider: &fakeStream{}, Tools: tools.NewRegistry(), Cortex: store, Model: "m"})
	srv := httptest.NewServer(Handler(ag, store, nil, nil, nil))
	defer srv.Close()

	resp, err := http.Post(srv.URL+"/chat/stream", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"prompt":"hi","mode":"chat"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("post: %v", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if ct := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"); !strings.Contains(ct, "text/event-stream") {
		t.Fatalf("content-type = %q", ct)
	}
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	var tokens, reply string
	var sawDone bool
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(body), "\n") {
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
			continue
		}
		var e agent.Event
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")), &e); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		switch e.Type {
		case agent.EventToken:
			tokens += e.Text
		case agent.EventDone:
			sawDone = true
			reply = e.Reply
		case agent.EventError:
			t.Fatalf("unexpected error event: %s", e.Err)
		}
	}
	if tokens != "WIRED" {
		t.Errorf("streamed tokens = %q, want WIRED", tokens)
	}
	if !sawDone || reply != "WIRED" {
		t.Errorf("done reply = %q (sawDone=%v), want WIRED", reply, sawDone)
	}
}

	tracker := llm.NewTracker()

	srv := httptest.NewServer(Handler(ag, store, nil, nil, tracker))
	defer srv.Close()

	resp, err := http.Get(srv.URL + "/usage")

		t.Fatalf("get: %v", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

		TotalTokens int `json:"total_tokens"`
		Models      []struct {
			Model       string `json:"model"`
			Local       bool   `json:"local"`
			Requests    int    `json:"requests"`
			TotalTokens int    `json:"total_tokens"`
		} `json:"models"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&out); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode: %v", err)
	}
	if out.TotalTokens != 165 {

		t.Fatalf("models = %d, want 1", len(out.Models))

	if m.Model != "qwen3:8b" || !m.Local || m.Requests != 2 || m.TotalTokens != 165 {
		t.Errorf("model usage = %+v", m)
	}
}

func TestServerSessionIDORProtection(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := cortex.NewMemoryStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "cortex.json"))
	ag := agent.New(agent.Config{Provider: &fakeText{"ok"}, Tools: tools.NewRegistry(), Cortex: store, Model: "m"})

	// Mock session store with user A
	sessStore, err := cortex.NewFileSessionStore(t.TempDir())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("new file session store: %v", err)
	}
	sessA, err := sessStore.CreateSession(context.Background(), "Alice's Secret Chat", "user_alice")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create session: %v", err)
	}

	handler := Handler(ag, store, sessStore, nil, nil)

	// User Bob attempts to access Alice's session -> must be rejected with 403 Forbidden
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/sessions/"+sessA.ID, nil)
	// Inject user_bob into context
	req = req.WithContext(context.WithValue(req.Context(), ctxUserID, "user_bob"))
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(w, req)

	if w.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Errorf("IDOR vulnerability: got status %d, want 403 Forbidden", w.Code)
	}

	// User Alice accesses Alice's session -> must succeed 200 OK
	reqAlice := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/sessions/"+sessA.ID, nil)
	reqAlice = reqAlice.WithContext(context.WithValue(reqAlice.Context(), ctxUserID, "user_alice"))
	wAlice := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(wAlice, reqAlice)

	if wAlice.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("expected 200 OK for rightful session owner, got %d", wAlice.Code)
	}
}

// TestServerModeIsPerRequest proves the N2 fix: a /chat request carrying
// mode=bypass, and a /api/mobile/mode call, must not flip the shared agent's
// stored mode for every other user.
func TestServerModeIsPerRequest(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := cortex.NewMemoryStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "cortex.json"))
	ag := agent.New(agent.Config{Provider: &fakeText{"ok"}, Tools: tools.NewRegistry(), Cortex: store, Model: "m"})
	srv := httptest.NewServer(Handler(ag, store, nil, nil, nil))
	defer srv.Close()

	if got := ag.Mode(); got != agent.ModeEdit {
		t.Fatalf("precondition: agent mode = %q, want edit", got)
	}

	resp, err := http.Post(srv.URL+"/chat", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"prompt":"hi","mode":"bypass"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("chat post: %v", err)
	}
	resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("chat status = %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	if got := ag.Mode(); got != agent.ModeEdit {
		t.Errorf("after bypass /chat request: agent mode = %q, want edit (no global flip)", got)
	}

	resp, err = http.Post(srv.URL+"/api/mobile/mode", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"session_id":"s1","mode":"bypass"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mobile mode post: %v", err)
	}
	resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("mobile mode status = %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	if got := ag.Mode(); got != agent.ModeEdit {
		t.Errorf("after /api/mobile/mode: agent mode = %q, want edit (mode must be per-session)", got)
	}

	resp, err = http.Post(srv.URL+"/api/mobile/mode", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"mode":"bypass"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mobile mode post: %v", err)
	}
	resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Errorf("mobile mode without session_id: status = %d, want 400", resp.StatusCode)
	}
}

// TestIsLoopbackAddr covers the F16 remainder guard's address classification:
// only loopback binds may serve without an auth store.
func TestIsLoopbackAddr(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]bool{
		"127.0.0.1:8420": true,
		"localhost:8420": true,
		"[::1]:8420":     true,
		":8420":          false,
		"0.0.0.0:8420":   false,
		"192.168.1.5:80": false,
		"not-an-addr":    false,
	}
	for addr, want := range cases {
		if got := isLoopbackAddr(addr); got != want {
			t.Errorf("isLoopbackAddr(%q) = %v, want %v", addr, got, want)
		}
	}
}

// TestWriteErrorJSONEscapes proves the F20 fix: an error message containing
// quotes still produces one valid JSON document with the exact message.
func TestWriteErrorJSONEscapes(t *testing.T) {
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	writeErrorJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, `smtp "quoted" failure`)
	if w.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Errorf("status = %d, want 500", w.Code)
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("error body is not valid JSON: %v (%s)", err, w.Body.String())

	}
}

package server

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/agent"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/cortex"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/llm"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/tools"
)

// steerRunProvider is a run-aware recording provider: the first Generate of
// each run (messages end with the fresh user prompt) returns one tool call so
// the loop reaches the steer-drain point; the follow-up Generate (messages
// end with the tool result) returns final text. It records every message it
// is shown so tests can prove which run a steering instruction reached.
type steerRunProvider struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	seen []string
}

func (p *steerRunProvider) ID() string { return "steerrun" }
func (p *steerRunProvider) Generate(_ context.Context, req llm.GenerateRequest) (llm.GenerateResponse, error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	for _, m := range req.Messages {
		p.seen = append(p.seen, m.Content)
	}
	if n := len(req.Messages); n == 0 || req.Messages[n-1].Role != "tool" {
		return llm.GenerateResponse{
			ToolCalls:    []llm.ToolCall{{ID: "tc1", Name: "todo", Arguments: "{}"}},
			FinishReason: "tool_calls",
		}, nil
	}
	return llm.GenerateResponse{Content: "run reply", FinishReason: "stop"}, nil
}
func (p *steerRunProvider) Stream(context.Context, llm.GenerateRequest) (<-chan llm.StreamEvent, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (p *steerRunProvider) sawSteering(msg string) bool {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	for _, s := range p.seen {
		if strings.Contains(s, "[User steering instruction]: "+msg) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// steerSessionFixture is newMobileFixture with the run-aware provider, so a
// test can steer one session and then run /chat on a specific other session.
type steerSessionFixture struct {
	handler http.Handler
	prov    *steerRunProvider
	alice   string
	bob     string
}

func newSteerSessionFixture(t *testing.T) *steerSessionFixture {
	t.Helper()
	store, err := cortex.NewMemoryStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "cortex.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store: %v", err)
	}
	sessStore, err := cortex.NewFileSessionStore(t.TempDir())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("session store: %v", err)
	}
	sessA, err := sessStore.CreateSession(context.Background(), "Alice chat", "user_alice")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create alice session: %v", err)
	}
	sessB, err := sessStore.CreateSession(context.Background(), "Bob chat", "user_bob")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create bob session: %v", err)
	}
	prov := &steerRunProvider{}
	ag := agent.New(agent.Config{Provider: prov, Tools: tools.NewRegistry(), Cortex: store, Model: "m"})
	return &steerSessionFixture{
		handler: Handler(ag, store, sessStore, nil, nil),
		prov:    prov,
		alice:   sessA.ID,
		bob:     sessB.ID,
	}
}

func (f *steerSessionFixture) chatAs(t *testing.T, userID, sessionID string) {
	t.Helper()
	body := `{"prompt":"go"}`
	if sessionID != "" {
		body = `{"prompt":"go","session_id":"` + sessionID + `"}`
	}
	w := postAs(f.handler, "/chat", body, userID)
	if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("chat as %q on session %q: status = %d, want 200 (body: %s)",
			userID, sessionID, w.Code, w.Body.String())
	}
}

// TestMobileSteerStaysInOwnSession is the FIX 1 cross-user delivery proof:
// Bob steers HIS OWN session (accepted, as before), but the instruction may
// only ever be delivered into a run of Bob's session. Alice's run on her own
// session and a sessionless run must never see it; Bob's own run must.
// (On the pre-fix code the steer sat in one global channel and Alice's run,
// whichever came first, drained it.)
func TestMobileSteerStaysInOwnSession(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSteerSessionFixture(t)

	w := postAs(f.handler, "/api/mobile/steer",
		`{"session_id":"`+f.bob+`","message":"bob pivot now"}`, "user_bob")
	if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("bob steer own session: status = %d, want 200 (body: %s)", w.Code, w.Body.String())
	}

	// Alice runs /chat on HER session: Bob's steer must not reach her model.
	f.chatAs(t, "user_alice", f.alice)
	if f.prov.sawSteering("bob pivot now") {
		t.Fatal("cross-user leak: Bob's steer was delivered into Alice's run")
	}

	// A sessionless run drains nothing either (fail closed).
	f.chatAs(t, "", "")
	if f.prov.sawSteering("bob pivot now") {
		t.Fatal("sessionless run received a session-bound steer")
	}

	// Bob runs /chat on HIS session: his steer is delivered there.
	f.chatAs(t, "user_bob", f.bob)
	if !f.prov.sawSteering("bob pivot now") {
		t.Fatal("Bob's steer was never delivered into Bob's own run")
	}
}

// TestMobileSteerQueueFullReturns429 is the FIX 2 proof: a session's steer
// queue has a cap; once it is full the endpoint must say so (429) instead of
// answering 200 while silently dropping the instruction. (On the pre-fix
// code every request returns 200 and the overflow is dropped by a
// non-blocking channel send.)
func TestMobileSteerQueueFullReturns429(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMobileFixture(t)
	body := `{"session_id":"` + f.bob + `","message":"queued steer"}`
	// The per-session cap is 16 (agent.maxSteersPerSession); keep this in
	// sync if the cap changes.
	for i := 1; i <= 16; i++ {
		w := postAs(f.handler, "/api/mobile/steer", body, "user_bob")
		if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("steer %d of 16: status = %d, want 200 (body: %s)", i, w.Code, w.Body.String())
		}
	}
	w := postAs(f.handler, "/api/mobile/steer", body, "user_bob")
	if w.Code != http.StatusTooManyRequests {
		t.Fatalf("steer beyond the queue cap: status = %d, want 429 (body: %s)", w.Code, w.Body.String())
	}
}

<script>
/* ===== AUTH (delegates to /auth page) ===== */

function authCheck(){
  var token = localStorage.getItem('mimir-token');
  if(!token){ window.location.href = '/auth'; return false; }
  return true;
}

function authSetUser(email){
  localStorage.setItem('mimir-email', email);
  el('authUserEmail').textContent = email;
  el('authUserBtn').style.display = 'flex';
}

function authClearUser(){
  localStorage.removeItem('mimir-token');
  localStorage.removeItem('mimir-email');
  el('authUserBtn').style.display = 'none';
}

function authLogout(){
  authClearUser();
  window.location.href = '/auth';
}

function authFetch(url, options){
  options = options || {};
  options.headers = options.headers || {};
  var token = localStorage.getItem('mimir-token');
  if(token) options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token;
  if(options.method !== 'GET' && !options.headers['Content-Type']) options.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
  return fetch(url, options).then(function(r){
    if(r.status === 401){
      authClearUser();
      window.location.href = '/auth';
      throw new Error('unauthorized');
    }
    return r;
  });
}
function el(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]})}

/* ===== live state ===== */
var memCache = [];
var usageCache = {total_tokens:0, models:[]};
var enginesCache = {engines:[]};
var swarmCache = {tasks:[]};
var healthOK = false;
var sending = false;
var showTrace = true;
var mode = 'chat';

/* ===== GLOW STYLE (F2.3 chat animation) ===== */
var glowStyles = ['pulse','snake','ripple','neon','aurora','breathe','off'];
var glowLabels = {pulse:'Pulse',snake:'Snake',ripple:'Ripple',neon:'Neon',aurora:'Aurora',breathe:'Breathe',off:'Off'};
var glowIdx = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('mimir-glow')||'0',10);
if(glowIdx<0||glowIdx>=glowStyles.length) glowIdx=0;
function applyGlow(){
  var s=glowStyles[glowIdx];
  document.querySelectorAll('.msg.agent .bubble').forEach(function(b){
    b.className=b.className.replace(/ glow-\w+/g,'');
    if(s!=='pulse') b.classList.add('glow-'+s);
  });
  var pill=el('glowPill');
  if(pill) pill.textContent=glowLabels[s];
}
function cycleGlow(){ glowIdx=(glowIdx+1)%glowStyles.length; localStorage.setItem('mimir-glow',glowIdx); applyGlow(); }

/* ===== SESSION STATE (F2.2) ===== */
var currentSessionId = null;
var sessions = [];

/* ===== refresh engines and swarm ===== */
function refreshEngines(){
  return authFetch('/api/engines').then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    enginesCache = d||{engines:[]};
    if(openPanels.indexOf('engines')>=0) renderPanels();
  }).catch(function(){});
}

function refreshSwarm(){
  return authFetch('/api/swarm').then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    swarmCache = d||{tasks:[]};
    if(openPanels.indexOf('swarm')>=0) renderPanels();
  }).catch(function(){});
}

/* ===== accent ===== */
function setAccent(e,c,cd){ document.querySelectorAll('.swatch').forEach(function(s){s.classList.remove('active')}); e.classList.add('active');
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--teal',c); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--teal-d',cd); }

/* ===== toast / settings ===== */
function toast(html){ var t=el('toast'); t.innerHTML=html; t.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(t._t); t._t=setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show')},3200); }
function openSettings(){ el('settingsModal').classList.add('open'); }
function closeSettings(){ el('settingsModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function toggleTrace(e){ e.classList.toggle('on'); showTrace=e.classList.contains('on'); }
function setMode(m){ mode=m; el('modeChat').classList.toggle('active',m==='chat'); el('modeTrace').classList.toggle('active',m==='trace');
  showTrace = (m==='trace'); el('tglTrace').classList.toggle('on',showTrace); }

/* collapse / expand the left navigation rail */
function toggleRail(){
  document.querySelector('.body').classList.toggle('nav-compact');
  el('railBtn').textContent = document.querySelector('.body').classList.contains('nav-compact') ? '☰' : '✕';
}

/* open / close the chat drawer (tablet & mobile) */
function toggleChat(){ document.body.classList.toggle('chat-open'); }

/* ===== health (live) ===== */
function checkHealth(manual){
  fetch('/health').then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    healthOK = (d.status==='ok');
    var core=el('reactorCore'), dot=el('statusDot');
    core.style.background = healthOK?'var(--lime)':'var(--red)';
    core.style.boxShadow = '0 0 10px '+(healthOK?'var(--lime)':'var(--red)');
    el('reactorLabel').textContent = healthOK?'live':'down';
    dot.className = 'dot '+(healthOK?'ok':'bad');
    el('statusText').textContent = healthOK?'daemon · online':'daemon · unreachable';
    if(openPanels.indexOf('dashboard')>=0) renderPanels();
    if(manual) toast(healthOK?'Daemon is <b>online</b>':'Daemon is <b>unreachable</b>');
  }).catch(function(){
    healthOK=false; el('statusDot').className='dot bad'; el('statusText').textContent='daemon · unreachable';
    el('reactorLabel').textContent='down';
  });
}

/* ===== memory (live) ===== */
function refreshMemory(){
  return authFetch('/memory').then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    memCache = d.neurons||[];
    el('memPill').textContent = memCache.length+(memCache.length===1?' memory':' memories');
    if(openPanels.indexOf('cortex')>=0 || openPanels.indexOf('dashboard')>=0) renderPanels();
  }).catch(function(){});
}

function refreshUsage(){
  return authFetch('/usage').then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    usageCache = {total_tokens:d.total_tokens||0, models:d.models||[]};
    if(openPanels.indexOf('dashboard')>=0) renderPanels();
  }).catch(function(){});
}

/* ===== SESSIONS (F2.2) ===== */
function refreshSessions(){
  return authFetch('/sessions').then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(d){
    sessions = d.sessions||[];
    renderSessionList();
  }).catch(function(){});
}

function renderSessionList(){
  var list = el('sessionList');
  if(!sessions.length){
    list.innerHTML='<div class="session-empty">No conversations yet.<br>Click + to start one.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML=sessions.map(function(s){
    var active = s.id===currentSessionId ? ' active' : '';
    var msgCount = (s.messages||[]).length;
    var time = s.updated_at ? new Date(s.updated_at).toLocaleDateString()+' '+new Date(s.updated_at).toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) : '';
    var icon = '💬';
    return '<div class="session-item'+active+'" data-id="'+s.id+'">'+
      '<div class="session-compact-icon" onclick="loadSession(\''+s.id+'\')">'+icon+'</div>'+
      '<div class="sname" ondblclick="startRename(\''+s.id+'\')" onclick="loadSession(\''+s.id+'\')">'+esc(s.title||'Untitled')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="stime">'+time+'</div>'+
      '<div class="scount">'+msgCount+' messages</div>'+
      '<div class="session-actions">'+
        '<span class="act act-pin" onclick="event.stopPropagation();pinSession(\''+s.id+'\',\''+esc(s.title||'Untitled')+'\')" title="Pin to hotrail">📌</span>'+
        '<span class="act act-rename" onclick="event.stopPropagation();startRename(\''+s.id+'\')" title="Rename">✏️</span>'+
        '<span class="act act-del" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteSession(\''+s.id+'\')" title="Delete">🗑</span>'+
      '</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function newSession(){
  authFetch('/sessions',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({title:'New Conversation'})})
    .then(function(r){return r.json()})
    .then(function(s){
      currentSessionId = s.id;
      localStorage.setItem('mimir-session', s.id);
      el('sessionTitle').textContent = '· '+s.title;
      welcome();
      refreshSessions();
      toast('New conversation started');
    }).catch(function(){toast('Failed to create session')});
}

function loadSession(id){
  authFetch('/sessions/'+id)
    .then(function(r){
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error('not found');
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(function(s){
      currentSessionId = s.id;
      localStorage.setItem('mimir-session', s.id);
      el('sessionTitle').textContent = '· '+s.title;
      renderSessionHistory(s.messages||[]);
      refreshSessions();
    }).catch(function(){
      localStorage.removeItem('mimir-session');
      currentSessionId=null;
      el('sessionTitle').textContent='· new conversation';
      welcome();
    });
}

function renderSessionHistory(messages){
  var b = el('chatBody');
  b.innerHTML='';
  messages.forEach(function(m){
    if(m.role==='user'){
      appendUser(m.content);
    } else if(m.role==='assistant'){
      appendAssistant(m.content);
    }
  });
}

function appendAssistant(text){
  var b=el('chatBody');
  var rendered = renderChoices(esc(text));
  b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="msg agent">'+agentHeader()+
    '<div class="bubble">'+rendered+'</div></div>');
  applyGlow();
  scrollDown();
}

/* ===== CHOICE RENDERING (F2.4) ===== */
/* Format: [choice]\nA) option\nB) option\n[/choice] */
function renderChoices(text){
  return text.replace(/\[choice\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/choice\]/g, function(_, inner){
    var lines=inner.trim().split('\n');
    var btns='';
    lines.forEach(function(line){
      line=line.trim();
      if(!line) return;
      var m=line.match(/^([A-Za-z])\)\s*(.+)/);
      if(m){
        btns+='<button class="choice-btn" onclick="pickChoice(this,\''+esc(m[2])+'\')">'+
          '<span class="clabel">'+esc(m[1])+')'+'</span>'+
          '<span class="ctext">'+esc(m[2])+'</span></button>';
      }
    });
    return '<div class="choices">'+btns+'</div>';
  });
}
function pickChoice(btn, text){
  var all=btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn');
  all.forEach(function(b){b.classList.add('selected');b.onclick=null;});
  btn.style.borderColor='var(--lime)';
  el('input').value=text;
  send();
}

function deleteSession(id){
  authFetch('/sessions/'+id,{method:'DELETE'})
    .then(function(){
      if(currentSessionId===id){currentSessionId=null;el('sessionTitle').textContent='· new conversation';welcome();}
      refreshSessions();
      toast('Conversation deleted');
    }).catch(function(){toast('Failed to delete session')});
}

/* ===== RENAME SESSION ===== */
function startRename(id){
  var items = document.querySelectorAll('.session-item');
  var item = null;
  items.forEach(function(i){if(i.getAttribute('data-id')===id)item=i;});
  if(!item)return;
  var nameEl = item.querySelector('.sname');
  var current = nameEl.textContent;
  nameEl.innerHTML = '<input class="inline-rename" id="renameInput" value="'+esc(current)+'" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\')saveRename(\''+id+'\')" onblur="saveRename(\''+id+'\')" autofocus>';
  var inp = el('renameInput');
  if(inp){inp.focus();inp.select();}
}
function saveRename(id){
  var inp = el('renameInput');
  if(!inp)return;
  var title = inp.value.trim() || 'Untitled';
  authFetch('/sessions/'+id,{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({title:title})})
    .then(function(r){return r.json()})
    .then(function(){
      if(currentSessionId===id)el('sessionTitle').textContent='· '+title;
      refreshSessions();
      toast('Renamed to "'+title+'"');
    }).catch(function(){toast('Failed to rename');refreshSessions();});
}

/* ===== PIN SESSION ===== */
function pinSession(id, title){
  var h = el('hotrail');
  var existing = h.querySelector('.hot[data-pinned="'+id+'"]');
  if(existing){toast('Already pinned');return;}
  var dot = document.createElement('div');
  dot.className = 'hot';
  dot.setAttribute('data-pinned',id);
  dot.innerHTML = '💬<span class="pin"></span>';
  dot.title = title;
  dot.onclick = function(){loadSession(id);};
  h.insertBefore(dot, h.querySelector('.hot-add'));
  toast('Pinned "'+title+'"');
}

function renderSpines(){
  el('spines').innerHTML=spineDefs.map(function(s){
    return '<div class="spine '+(openPanels.indexOf(s.id)>=0?'open':'')+'" onclick="togglePanel(\''+s.id+'\')" title="'+s.label+'">'+s.label+'</div>';
  }).join('');
}
function renderPanels(){
  el('panels').innerHTML=openPanels.map(function(id){
    var def=spineDefs.find(function(s){return s.id===id});
    var badge = def.live ? '<span class="live">LIVE</span>' : '<span class="soon">SOON</span>';
    return '<div class="panel" data-id="'+id+'" ondragover="panelDragOver(event,this)" ondrop="panelDrop(event,this)" ondragleave="this.classList.remove(\'drag-over\')">'+
      '<div class="panel-h" draggable="true" ondragstart="panelDragStart(event,\''+id+'\')"><span class="grip">::</span><span class="ptitle">'+def.label+'</span>'+badge+'<span class="pclose" onclick="closePanel(\''+id+'\')" onmousedown="event.stopPropagation()">x</span></div>'+
      '<div class="panel-b">'+panelContent[id]()+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}
function togglePanel(id){
  var i=openPanels.indexOf(id);
  if(i>=0){ openPanels.splice(i,1); }
  else{ openPanels.push(id); if(openPanels.length>2) openPanels.shift(); }
  renderSpines(); renderPanels();
}
function openSpine(id){ if(openPanels.indexOf(id)<0) togglePanel(id); }
function closePanel(id){ openPanels=openPanels.filter(function(x){return x!==id}); renderSpines(); renderPanels(); }
function panelDragStart(e,id){ e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',id); e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move'; }
function panelDragOver(e,target){ e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='move'; target.classList.add('drag-over'); }
function panelDrop(e,target){ e.preventDefault(); target.classList.remove('drag-over');
  var from=e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'), to=target.dataset.id;
  if(from&&to&&from!==to){ var fi=openPanels.indexOf(from), ti=openPanels.indexOf(to);
    if(fi>=0&&ti>=0){ openPanels.splice(ti,0,openPanels.splice(fi,1)[0]); renderPanels(); toast('Moved <b>'+defLabel(from)+'</b> panel'); } } }
function defLabel(id){ var d=spineDefs.find(function(s){return s.id===id}); return d?d.label:id; }

/* ===== CHAT (live wire to /chat/stream) ===== */
function onKey(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); send(); } }
function autogrow(t){ t.style.height='auto'; t.style.height=Math.min(t.scrollHeight,120)+'px'; }
function scrollDown(){ var b=el('chatBody'); b.scrollTop=b.scrollHeight; }

function agentHeader(){ return '<div class="who"><span class="pd avatar-glow" style="background:var(--teal)">M</span><b>Mímir</b><span class="role">the rememberer</span></div>'; }

function welcome(){
  var b=el('chatBody');
  b.innerHTML='<div class="msg agent">'+agentHeader()+
    '<div class="bubble">I am Mímir - the agent that remembers. Tell me something and I will recall it across every session. Ask me to run a command and I will use my tools. Everything I learn lives in the Cortex on the left.</div></div>';
  applyGlow();
}

function appendUser(text){
  var b=el('chatBody');
  b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="msg"><div class="who"><span class="pd" style="background:var(--panel3);color:var(--text)">Y</span><b>You</b></div><div class="bubble user">'+esc(text)+'</div></div>');
  scrollDown();
}
function toolChip(s){
  s=s||{};
  var ok=!s.err;
  var tc=document.createElement('div'); tc.className='toolcall';
  tc.innerHTML='<div class="th"><span class="'+(ok?'ok':'bad')+'">'+(ok?'v':'!')+'</span> <code>'+esc(s.name)+'</code>'+(s.args?' · '+esc(s.args):'')+'</div>'+
    (s.result?'<div class="tres">-&gt; '+esc(s.result)+'</div>':'')+
    (s.err?'<div class="tres" style="color:var(--red)">!! '+esc(s.err)+'</div>':'');
  return tc;
}

function send(){
  var t=el('input'); var p=t.value.trim();
  if(!p||sending) return;
  
  // Auto-create session if none active
  if(!currentSessionId){
    authFetch('/sessions',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({title:p.substring(0,50)})})
      .then(function(r){return r.json()})
      .then(function(s){
        currentSessionId = s.id;
        el('sessionTitle').textContent = '· '+s.title;
        doSend(p);
        refreshSessions();
      }).catch(function(){doSend(p);});
  } else {
    doSend(p);
  }
}

function doSend(p){
  sending=true;
  appendUser(p);
  el('input').value=''; autogrow(el('input'));

  var msg=document.createElement('div'); msg.className='msg agent';
  msg.innerHTML=agentHeader()+
    '<div class="bubble"><span class="thinking-line"><span class="pulse"></span> Mímir is thinking...</span></div>'+
    '<div class="tool-row"></div>';
  el('chatBody').appendChild(msg);
  var bubble=msg.querySelector('.bubble');
  var toolRow=msg.querySelector('.tool-row');
  var thinking=bubble.querySelector('.thinking-line');
  var replySpan=null;
  var fullText='';
  scrollDown();

  function onEvent(e){
    if(e.type==='memory'){
      var mc=document.createElement('span'); mc.className='memchip';
      mc.innerHTML='<span class="mk">memory</span> '+esc(e.text);
      bubble.insertBefore(mc, thinking||replySpan||null);
    } else if(e.type==='token'){
      if(thinking){ thinking.remove(); thinking=null; }
      fullText+=e.text;
      if(fullText.indexOf('[choice]')>=0){
        if(!replySpan){ replySpan=document.createElement('span'); replySpan.className='reply-text'; bubble.appendChild(replySpan); }
        replySpan.innerHTML=renderChoices(esc(fullText));
      } else {
        if(!replySpan){ replySpan=document.createElement('span'); replySpan.className='reply-text'; bubble.appendChild(replySpan); }
        replySpan.textContent=fullText;
      }
    } else if(e.type==='tool'){
      if(showTrace){ toolRow.appendChild(toolChip(e.step)); }
    } else if(e.type==='done'){
      if(thinking){ thinking.remove(); thinking=null; }
      if(replySpan && fullText.indexOf('[choice]')>=0){
        replySpan.innerHTML=renderChoices(esc(fullText));
      }
      applyGlow();
      refreshMemory();
      refreshUsage();
      refreshSessions();
    } else if(e.type==='error'){
      if(thinking){ thinking.remove(); thinking=null; }
      bubble.innerHTML='<span style="color:var(--red)">'+esc(e.err||'error')+'</span>';
    }
  }

  authFetch('/chat/stream',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({prompt:p,mode:mode,session_id:currentSessionId||''})})
    .then(function(r){
      if(!r.ok) return r.text().then(function(x){ throw new Error(x||('HTTP '+r.status)); });
      var reader=r.body.getReader();
      var decoder=new TextDecoder();
      var buf='';
      function pump(){
        return reader.read().then(function(res){
          if(res.done) return;
          buf+=decoder.decode(res.value,{stream:true});
          var parts=buf.split('\n\n');
          buf=parts.pop();
          parts.forEach(function(part){
            var line=part.trim();
            if(line.indexOf('data: ')!==0) return;
            try{ onEvent(JSON.parse(line.slice(6))); }catch(_){}
          });
          scrollDown();
          return pump();
        });
      }
      return pump();
    })
    .catch(function(err){
      if(thinking) thinking.remove();
      if(!replySpan) bubble.innerHTML='<span style="color:var(--red)">'+esc(err.message||String(err))+'</span>';
    })
    .then(function(){ sending=false; });
}

/* ===== boot ===== */
if(!authCheck()) throw 'redirect to /auth';
var email = localStorage.getItem('mimir-email');
if(email) authSetUser(email);
renderSpines(); renderPanels(); refreshMemory(); refreshUsage(); refreshEngines(); refreshSwarm(); checkHealth(false); applyGlow();
var savedSession = localStorage.getItem('mimir-session');
if(savedSession){
  loadSession(savedSession);
} else {
  welcome();
  refreshSessions();
}
setInterval(function(){checkHealth(false); refreshUsage(); refreshEngines(); refreshSwarm();},15000);
</script>
</body>
</html>

package swarm

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/agent"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/critic"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/runengine"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/tools"
)

// TaskState tracks the lifecycle of an autonomous factory task through the Norse personas.
type TaskState string

const (
	StateBacklog       TaskState = "backlog"        // Waiting for specification
	StateSpec          TaskState = "spec"           // Odin (Orchestrator) writing requirements
	StateImplement     TaskState = "implement"      // Thor (Builder) developing in worktree
	StateTest          TaskState = "test"           // Loki (Tester/Debugger) validating and fixing
	StateReview        TaskState = "review"         // Heimdall (Auditor) running SEO/GEO and web audit
	StateAwaitingMerge TaskState = "awaiting_merge" // All gates passed; a human must call ApproveMerge
	StateMerged        TaskState = "merged"         // Merged back to target branch after human approval
	StateBlocked       TaskState = "blocked"        // Cannot proceed without external input (e.g. no agent configured)
	StateFailed        TaskState = "failed"         // Halted due to unrecoverable test or review failure
)

// ErrNoAgentConfigured is returned when a task reaches the Thor build phase
// but the factory has no agent configured to do the work. The task is left
// in StateBlocked, never reported as built.
var ErrNoAgentConfigured = errors.New("swarm: no agent configured (FactoryConfig.AgentConfig.Provider is nil); Thor cannot implement tasks")

// Task represents a discrete unit of work assigned to the autonomous software factory.
type Task struct {
	ID          string            `json:"id"`
	Title       string            `json:"title"`
	Description string            `json:"description"`
	Branch      string            `json:"branch"`
	WorktreeDir string            `json:"worktree_dir,omitempty"`
	State       TaskState         `json:"state"`
	AssignedTo  string            `json:"assigned_to"` // "odin" | "thor" | "loki" | "heimdall"
	Error       string            `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Artifacts   []string          `json:"artifacts,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time         `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time         `json:"updated_at"`
	Metadata    map[string]string `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
}

// FactoryConfig configures the autonomous software factory queue.
type FactoryConfig struct {
	RootDir      string
	MaxWorkers   int
	AgentConfig  agent.Config
	RunLimits    runengine.Limits
	TargetBranch string // default "main"
}

// Factory manages parallel multi-agent worker pipelines operating in isolated git worktrees.
type Factory struct {
	mu           sync.RWMutex
	cfg          FactoryConfig
	tasks        map[string]*Task
	taskOrder    []string
	nextID       int // persisted monotonic counter for task IDs (N12)
	worktreeRoot string
}

// NewFactory creates an autonomous software factory instance.
func NewFactory(cfg FactoryConfig) *Factory {
	if cfg.RootDir == "" {
		cfg.RootDir = "."
	}
	if cfg.MaxWorkers <= 0 {
		cfg.MaxWorkers = 4
	}
	if cfg.TargetBranch == "" {
		cfg.TargetBranch = "main"
	}
	wtBase := filepath.Join(cfg.RootDir, ".mimir", "worktrees")
	fac := &Factory{
		cfg:          cfg,
		tasks:        make(map[string]*Task),
		taskOrder:    make([]string, 0),
		worktreeRoot: wtBase,
	}
	fac.loadFromDisk()
	return fac
}

func (f *Factory) storagePath() string {
	return filepath.Join(f.cfg.RootDir, ".mimir", "swarm", "tasks.json")
}

// factoryStore is the on-disk form of the factory queue. NextID persists the
// task ID counter so IDs stay unique across process restarts and reloads.
type factoryStore struct {
	Order  []string         `json:"order"`
	Tasks  map[string]*Task `json:"tasks"`
	NextID int              `json:"next_id"`
}

func (f *Factory) loadFromDisk() {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(f.storagePath())
	if err != nil {
		// A missing store is the normal first-run case and starts empty
		// quietly. Any other read failure is surfaced loudly: starting
		// empty on an unreadable store would hide real queue loss.
		if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			slog.Error("swarm: task store could not be read; starting with an empty queue",
				"path", f.storagePath(), "error", err)
		}
		return
	}
	var data factoryStore
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &data); err != nil {
		// A corrupt store is never silently discarded: preserve the
		// bytes under a side name for forensics and start empty, so the
		// next save writes a fresh store instead of overwriting the
		// evidence (audit FIX 3).
		aside := fmt.Sprintf("%s.corrupt-%d", f.storagePath(), time.Now().UnixNano())
		slog.Error("swarm: task store is corrupt; starting with an empty queue",
			"path", f.storagePath(), "preserved_as", aside, "error", err)
		if rerr := os.Rename(f.storagePath(), aside); rerr != nil {
			slog.Error("swarm: could not preserve corrupt task store; the next save will overwrite it",
				"path", f.storagePath(), "error", rerr)
		}
		return
	}
	f.taskOrder = data.Order
	f.tasks = data.Tasks
	if f.tasks == nil {
		f.tasks = make(map[string]*Task)
	}
	// Legacy stores have no counter: derive it from the highest existing ID
	// so a reloaded factory never reissues an ID (N12).
	f.nextID = data.NextID
	for id := range f.tasks {
		if n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(id, "task-")); err == nil && n > f.nextID {
			f.nextID = n
		}
	}
}

// saveToDisk persists the task queue. Persistence is part of the
// queue's correctness (the nextID guarantee lives in this file), so
// write failures are returned, never swallowed: a state that could not
// be persisted must not be reported as real (audit FIX 3).
func (f *Factory) saveToDisk() error {
	data := factoryStore{
		Order:  f.taskOrder,
		Tasks:  f.tasks,
		NextID: f.nextID,
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(data, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("swarm: encode task store: %w", err)
	}
	p := f.storagePath()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("swarm: create task store directory: %w", err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(p, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("swarm: write task store: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// Submit enqueues a new feature or bugfix task into the factory backlog.
func (f *Factory) Submit(title, description string) (*Task, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(title) == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("factory: task title cannot be empty")
	}

	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()

	// IDs come from a persisted monotonic counter, never from the live task
	// count, so reloads and deletions cannot reissue an ID (N12).
	f.nextID++
	id := fmt.Sprintf("task-%d", f.nextID)
	branch := fmt.Sprintf("swarm/%s-%s", id, sanitizeSlug(title))

	t := &Task{
		ID:          id,
		Title:       title,
		Description: description,
		Branch:      branch,
		State:       StateBacklog,
		AssignedTo:  "odin",
		CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
		UpdatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
		Metadata:    make(map[string]string),
	}

	f.tasks[id] = t
	f.taskOrder = append(f.taskOrder, id)
	if err := f.saveToDisk(); err != nil {
		// Roll back the in-memory insert: a task that is not on disk was
		// never queued. nextID is NOT rolled back; ID gaps are harmless,
		// ID reuse is not (N12).
		delete(f.tasks, id)
		f.taskOrder = f.taskOrder[:len(f.taskOrder)-1]
		return nil, err
	}
	// Trust-boundary record (audit FIX 5): identifiers only, never the
	// task description.
	slog.Info("swarm: task submitted", "task_id", t.ID, "branch", t.Branch)
	return t, nil
}

// sanitizeSlug reduces a task title to a git-ref-safe branch slug:
// lowercase [a-z0-9] words joined by single dashes, at most 30 chars,
// with a fallback when nothing usable remains (N12).
func sanitizeSlug(title string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	lastDash := false
	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(title)) {
		switch {
		case (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9'):
			b.WriteRune(r)
			lastDash = false
		case !lastDash:
			b.WriteByte('-')
			lastDash = true
		}
	}
	slug := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
	if len(slug) > 30 {
		slug = strings.TrimRight(slug[:30], "-")
	}
	if slug == "" {
		slug = "task"
	}
	return slug
}

// ListTasks returns all tasks in submission order.
func (f *Factory) ListTasks() []*Task {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	out := make([]*Task, 0, len(f.taskOrder))
	for _, id := range f.taskOrder {
		if t, ok := f.tasks[id]; ok {
			cp := *t
			out = append(out, &cp)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// GetTask returns a task by ID.
func (f *Factory) GetTask(id string) (*Task, bool) {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	t, ok := f.tasks[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	cp := *t
	return &cp, true
}

// ExecuteTask runs a single task through the full Odin -> Thor -> Loki -> Heimdall pipeline.
func (f *Factory) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	t, ok := f.tasks[taskID]
	if !ok {
		f.mu.Unlock()
		return fmt.Errorf("factory: task %q not found", taskID)
	}
	f.mu.Unlock()

	// 1. Odin: Specification Phase
	if err := f.updateState(taskID, StateSpec, "odin"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	specDoc, err := f.runOdinSpec(ctx, t)
	if err != nil {
		if serr := f.failTask(taskID, fmt.Sprintf("Odin spec phase failed: %v", err)); serr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v (also could not persist failed state: %w)", err, serr)
		}
		return err
	}
	if err := f.recordArtifact(taskID, specDoc); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 2. Thor: Implementation in isolated Git Worktree
	if err := f.updateState(taskID, StateImplement, "thor"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	wtDir, err := f.setupWorktree(t.Branch)
	if err != nil {
		if serr := f.failTask(taskID, fmt.Sprintf("Thor worktree setup failed: %v", err)); serr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v (also could not persist failed state: %w)", err, serr)
		}
		return err
	}
	defer f.teardownWorktree(wtDir)

	f.mu.Lock()
	t.WorktreeDir = wtDir
	f.mu.Unlock()

	if err := f.runThorImplement(ctx, t, wtDir, specDoc); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNoAgentConfigured) {
			// Honest stop, not a failure and never a fake build: the task
			// waits in StateBlocked until the factory is given an agent.
			if serr := f.blockTask(taskID, err.Error()); serr != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w (also could not persist blocked state: %v)", err, serr)
			}
			return err
		}
		if serr := f.failTask(taskID, fmt.Sprintf("Thor implementation failed: %v", err)); serr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v (also could not persist failed state: %w)", err, serr)
		}
		return err
	}

	// 3. Loki: Testing and Adversarial Debugging
	if err := f.updateState(taskID, StateTest, "loki"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := f.runLokiTesting(ctx, t, wtDir); err != nil {
		if serr := f.failTask(taskID, fmt.Sprintf("Loki test phase failed: %v", err)); serr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v (also could not persist failed state: %w)", err, serr)
		}
		return err
	}

	// 4. Heimdall: Review Gate, Epistemic Critic & Web Audit
	if err := f.updateState(taskID, StateReview, "heimdall"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := f.runHeimdallReview(ctx, t, wtDir); err != nil {
		if serr := f.failTask(taskID, fmt.Sprintf("Heimdall review gate failed: %v", err)); serr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v (also could not persist failed state: %w)", err, serr)
		}
		return err
	}

	// 5. Stop for human merge approval (N6). Passing every gate does NOT
	// merge: the task waits in StateAwaitingMerge until a human calls
	// ApproveMerge from the CLI or TUI. The committed task branch is left
	// intact; only the worktree is torn down.
	if err := f.updateState(taskID, StateAwaitingMerge, "none"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Gate pass summary (audit FIX 5): identifiers only.
	slog.Info("swarm: task passed all gates; awaiting merge approval", "task_id", taskID, "branch", t.Branch)
	return nil
}

// ApproveMerge is the human approval step for a task that passed all
// factory gates. It merges the task branch into the factory TargetBranch
// and marks the task StateMerged. The merge is refused when the main
// worktree is not currently on TargetBranch, so an approval can never land
// code on whatever branch happens to be checked out (N6).
func (f *Factory) ApproveMerge(ctx context.Context, taskID string) error {
	f.mu.RLock()
	t, ok := f.tasks[taskID]
	f.mu.RUnlock()
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("factory: task %q not found", taskID)
	}
	if t.State != StateAwaitingMerge {
		return fmt.Errorf("factory: task %q is in state %q, not %q; only gate-passed tasks can be approved for merge", taskID, t.State, StateAwaitingMerge)
	}

	// A refusal (wrong branch checked out) leaves the task awaiting merge so
	// the approval can be retried; only a failed merge attempt fails it.
	if current, err := f.currentBranch(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	} else if current != f.cfg.TargetBranch {
		return fmt.Errorf("factory: refusing to merge %s: main worktree is on branch %q but the target branch is %q; check out %q first", t.Branch, current, f.cfg.TargetBranch, f.cfg.TargetBranch)
	}

	// Trust-boundary records (audit FIX 5): the approval decision and
	// the merge itself, identifiers only.
	slog.Info("swarm: merge approved", "task_id", taskID, "branch", t.Branch)
	if err := f.mergeTaskBranch(ctx, t.Branch); err != nil {
		if serr := f.failTask(taskID, fmt.Sprintf("Git merge failed: %v", err)); serr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v (also could not persist failed state: %w)", err, serr)
		}
		return err
	}
	slog.Info("swarm: merge performed", "task_id", taskID, "branch", t.Branch)

	return f.updateState(taskID, StateMerged, "none")
}

// currentBranch returns the branch checked out in the main worktree.
func (f *Factory) currentBranch(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	head := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD")
	head.Dir = f.cfg.RootDir
	out, err := head.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot determine current branch of main worktree: %s (%v)", string(out), err)
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
}

func (f *Factory) updateState(id string, st TaskState, assignedTo string) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	if t, ok := f.tasks[id]; ok {
		t.State = st
		t.AssignedTo = assignedTo
		t.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		return f.saveToDisk()
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) failTask(id string, errMsg string) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	if t, ok := f.tasks[id]; ok {
		t.State = StateFailed
		t.Error = errMsg
		t.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		err := f.saveToDisk()
		// Gate and pipeline failures funnel through failTask, so this is
		// the fail-side summary record (audit FIX 5). Identifiers only:
		// the error text can carry model or tool output and stays out of
		// the log.
		slog.Error("swarm: task failed", "task_id", id, "branch", t.Branch)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) blockTask(id string, reason string) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	if t, ok := f.tasks[id]; ok {
		t.State = StateBlocked
		t.Error = reason
		t.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		return f.saveToDisk()
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) recordArtifact(id, path string) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	if t, ok := f.tasks[id]; ok {
		t.Artifacts = append(t.Artifacts, path)
		return f.saveToDisk()
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) runOdinSpec(ctx context.Context, t *Task) (string, error) {
	specPath := filepath.Join(f.cfg.RootDir, ".mimir", "sdlc", fmt.Sprintf("01-SPEC-%s.md", t.ID))
	_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(specPath), 0o755)

	content := fmt.Sprintf("# Factory Task Specification: %s (%s)\n\n"+
		"- **Objective**: %s\n"+
		"- **Branch**: `%s`\n"+
		"- **Assigned**: Odin (Orchestrator)\n\n"+
		"## Functional Scope\n%s\n\n"+
		"## Verification Law\n"+
		"- All unit and integration tests must pass cleanly.\n"+
		"- Zero em dashes allowed in code, comments, or documentation.\n"+
		"- Strict anti-slop copy guidelines enforced.\n",
		t.Title, t.ID, t.Title, t.Branch, t.Description)

	if err := os.WriteFile(specPath, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return specPath, nil
}

func (f *Factory) setupWorktree(branch string) (string, error) {
	_ = os.MkdirAll(f.worktreeRoot, 0o755)
	cleanName := strings.ReplaceAll(branch, "/", "-")
	wtDir := filepath.Join(f.worktreeRoot, cleanName)

	if _, err := os.Stat(wtDir); err == nil {
		_ = exec.Command("git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", wtDir).Run()
	}

	// Create worktree with a new branch branched off TargetBranch
	cmd := exec.Command("git", "worktree", "add", "-b", branch, wtDir, f.cfg.TargetBranch)
	cmd.Dir = f.cfg.RootDir
	if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		// If branch already exists, checkout without -b
		fallback := exec.Command("git", "worktree", "add", wtDir, branch)
		fallback.Dir = f.cfg.RootDir
		if fOut, fErr := fallback.CombinedOutput(); fErr != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("git worktree add failed: %s (%s)", string(out), string(fOut))
		}
	}

	return wtDir, nil
}

func (f *Factory) teardownWorktree(wtDir string) {
	if wtDir == "" {
		return
	}
	cmd := exec.Command("git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", wtDir)
	cmd.Dir = f.cfg.RootDir
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

// runThorImplement runs one real agent pass inside the task worktree using
// the factory's configured agent, then commits whatever the agent produced
// to the task branch so the branch (not the disposable worktree) carries
// the work into the review and merge gates. Without a configured agent it
// returns ErrNoAgentConfigured: Thor never fabricates a build record and
// claims work it did not do.
func (f *Factory) runThorImplement(ctx context.Context, t *Task, wtDir, specDoc string) error {
	if f.cfg.AgentConfig.Provider == nil {
		return ErrNoAgentConfigured
	}

	cfg := f.cfg.AgentConfig
	// The worker's tools must be rooted in the task worktree, not the main
	// checkout, so every file and shell action stays inside the jail.
	cfg.Tools = tools.Default(wtDir)
	if cfg.Mode == "" {
		// Autonomous worker: there is no human at this terminal to answer
		// approval prompts. The policy gate (cfg.Gate) still applies.
		cfg.Mode = agent.ModeBypass
	}
	worker := agent.New(cfg)

	specBody := ""
	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(specDoc); err == nil {
		specBody = string(raw)
	}
	prompt := fmt.Sprintf("You are Thor, the builder in an autonomous software factory. "+
		"Implement the task below inside the current workspace, which is a dedicated git worktree on branch %s. "+
		"Make the smallest complete change that satisfies the spec, run the project's tests if practical, then stop.\n\n"+
		"Task: %s\n\nDescription: %s\n\nSpecification:\n%s",
		t.Branch, t.Title, t.Description, specBody)
	if _, err := worker.Run(ctx, prompt, nil); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("thor agent run failed: %w", err)
	}

	buildRecord := filepath.Join(wtDir, ".mimir", "sdlc", fmt.Sprintf("04-BUILD-%s.md", t.ID))
	_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(buildRecord), 0o755)
	content := fmt.Sprintf("# Thor Implementation Record: %s\n\n"+
		"- Task ID: `%s`\n"+
		"- Worktree: `%s`\n"+
		"- Status: Agent pass complete; changes committed to `%s` for Loki verification\n",
		t.Title, t.ID, wtDir, t.Branch)
	if err := os.WriteFile(buildRecord, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return f.commitWorktreeChanges(ctx, wtDir, t)
}

// commitWorktreeChanges commits all pending worktree changes to the task
// branch. A clean worktree (agent changed nothing) is not an error.
func (f *Factory) commitWorktreeChanges(ctx context.Context, wtDir string, t *Task) error {
	status := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "status", "--porcelain")
	status.Dir = wtDir
	out, err := status.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("git status in worktree failed: %s (%v)", string(out), err)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(out)) == "" {
		return nil
	}
	add := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "add", "-A")
	add.Dir = wtDir
	if out, err := add.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("git add in worktree failed: %s (%v)", string(out), err)
	}
	commit := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "commit", "-m", fmt.Sprintf("feat(swarm): %s (%s)", t.Title, t.ID))
	commit.Dir = wtDir
	if out, err := commit.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("git commit in worktree failed: %s (%v)", string(out), err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) runLokiTesting(ctx context.Context, t *Task, wtDir string) error {
	// Execute Loki test verification inside the worktree
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "go", "test", "-count=1", "./...")
	cmd.Dir = wtDir
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("tests failed in worktree:\n%s", string(out))
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) runHeimdallReview(ctx context.Context, t *Task, wtDir string) error {
	// Heimdall runs the web audit and epistemic critic checks on modified files
	rep, err := tools.AuditWebDirectory(wtDir)
	if err == nil && !rep.PassAudit {
		return fmt.Errorf("web audit detector failed with %d findings", len(rep.Findings))
	}

	criticCheck := critic.AuditDeterministic("", t.Description)
	if !criticCheck.PassAudit {
		return fmt.Errorf("epistemic critic flagged task description: %s", criticCheck.RoutingReason)
	}

	return nil
}

func (f *Factory) mergeTaskBranch(ctx context.Context, branch string) error {
	// The merge must land on the configured target branch and nowhere else
	// (N6): refuse when the main worktree has a different branch checked out.
	current, err := f.currentBranch(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if current != f.cfg.TargetBranch {
		return fmt.Errorf("refusing to merge %s: main worktree is on branch %q but the target branch is %q; check out %q first", branch, current, f.cfg.TargetBranch, f.cfg.TargetBranch)
	}

	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "merge", "--no-ff", "-m", fmt.Sprintf("feat(swarm): merge %s", branch), branch)
	cmd.Dir = f.cfg.RootDir
	if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		// Abort conflicted merge if needed
		abort := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "merge", "--abort")
		abort.Dir = f.cfg.RootDir
		_ = abort.Run()
		return fmt.Errorf("git merge error: %s (%v)", string(out), err)
	}
	return nil
}

// FormatStatus renders a formatted overview of the factory task queue.
func (f *Factory) FormatStatus() string {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("## Mímir Level 3 Autonomous Software Factory\n")
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- **Total Tasks**: %d\n", len(f.tasks))
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- **Target Branch**: `%s`\n", f.cfg.TargetBranch)
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- **Worktree Base**: `%s`\n\n", f.worktreeRoot)

	if len(f.taskOrder) == 0 {
		b.WriteString("No tasks currently queued. Submit tasks with `mimir swarm add \"Title\" \"Description\"`.\n")
		return b.String()
	}

	for _, id := range f.taskOrder {
		t := f.tasks[id]
		stateBadge := strings.ToUpper(string(t.State))
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "* **[%s] %s (`%s`)**\n", stateBadge, t.Title, t.ID)
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - State: `%s` | Assigned To: `%s` | Branch: `%s`\n", t.State, t.AssignedTo, t.Branch)
		if t.Error != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - Error: **%s**\n", t.Error)
		}
		if len(t.Artifacts) > 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - Deliverables: %s\n", strings.Join(t.Artifacts, ", "))
		}
	}

	return strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")
}
