package tui

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/agent"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/config"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/cortex"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/ingest"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/llm"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/runengine"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/swarm"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/tools"
)

// Options configures the interactive Mímir TUI session.
type Options struct {
	Version    string
	Agent      *agent.Agent
	Tools      *tools.Registry
	Cortex     cortex.Store
	Sessions   cortex.SessionStore
	Usage      *llm.Tracker
	StoreDesc  string
	WebURL     string
	StartWebFn func() (string, error) // optional callback to start the Book-Spine Web UI on /web
	In         io.Reader
	Out        io.Writer
}

// Run launches the interactive Mímir terminal UI loop.
func Run(ctx context.Context, opts Options) error {
	in := opts.In
	if in == nil {
		in = os.Stdin
	}
	out := opts.Out
	if out == nil {
		out = os.Stdout
	}

	// Wire QuestionTool in the registry to our interactive terminal selector.
	if opts.Tools != nil {
		if qt, ok := opts.Tools.Get("question"); ok {
			if qTool, ok := qt.(*tools.QuestionTool); ok {
				qTool.AskFunc = func(qctx context.Context, qs []tools.Question) (string, error) {
					return PromptQuestions(qctx, in, out, qs)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	pid, model, _ := opts.Agent.ModelInfo()
	toolCount := 0
	if opts.Tools != nil {
		toolCount = len(opts.Tools.ForMode(opts.Agent.Mode()))
	}
	fmt.Fprint(out, RenderBanner(
		opts.Version, pid, model, opts.Agent.Mode(), opts.Agent.Effort(),
		opts.StoreDesc, opts.WebURL, toolCount,
	))

	var history []llm.Message
	var activePersona *agent.Persona
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(in)
	// Allow up to 1MB pasted prompts in the terminal.
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 64*1024), 1024*1024)

	for {
		pid, model, local := opts.Agent.ModelInfo()
		totalTok := 0
		if opts.Usage != nil {
			totalTok = opts.Usage.TotalTokens()
		}
		estTok := agent.EstimateTokens(history)
		fmt.Fprintln(out, RenderStatusBar(pid, model, opts.Agent.Mode(), opts.Agent.Effort(), estTok, totalTok, local, opts.Agent.SmolMode()))

		promptLabel := "mimir"
		if activePersona != nil {
			promptLabel = "mimir:" + activePersona.Name
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s%s ❯%s ", ansiGold+ansiBold, promptLabel, ansiReset)

		if !scanner.Scan() {
			fmt.Fprintln(out)
			return nil
		}
		line := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(scanner.Text(), "\ufeff"))
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}

		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "/") {
			quit, err := handleSlashCommand(ctx, line, &opts, &history, &activePersona, scanner, out)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s  error: %v%s\n", ansiRed, err, ansiReset)
			}
			if quit {
				return nil
			}
			continue
		}

		if pid == "none" || model == "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s  No model configured. Run /model to auto-detect local Ollama/LM Studio or set MIMIR_BASE_URL.%s\n\n", ansiRed, ansiReset)
			continue
		}

		userPrompt := line
		if activePersona != nil {
			userPrompt = fmt.Sprintf("[Persona: %s (%s)]\n%s\n\nUser request: %s",
				activePersona.Name, activePersona.Role, activePersona.FullPrompt(), line)
		}

		var replyBuf strings.Builder
		var streamedTokens bool
		fmt.Fprintln(out)

		err := opts.Agent.RunStream(ctx, userPrompt, history, func(ev agent.Event) {
			switch ev.Type {
			case agent.EventMemory:
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s◈ recalled:%s %s%s%s\n",
					ansiPurple, ansiReset, ansiDim, truncate(ev.Text, 85), ansiReset)
			case agent.EventTool:
				if streamedTokens {
					fmt.Fprintln(out)
					streamedTokens = false
				}
				if ev.Step != nil {
					fmt.Fprint(out, RenderToolPill(ev.Step.Name, ev.Step.Args, ev.Step.Result, ev.Step.Err))
				}
			case agent.EventToken:
				if !streamedTokens {
					fmt.Fprint(out, "  ")
					streamedTokens = true
				}
				replyBuf.WriteString(ev.Text)
				fmt.Fprint(out, strings.ReplaceAll(ev.Text, "\n", "\n  "))
			case agent.EventSteer:
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n  %s⚡ steered:%s %s\n", ansiGold, ansiReset, ev.Text)
			case agent.EventError:
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n  %s✗ %s%s\n", ansiRed, ev.Err, ansiReset)
			case agent.EventDone:
				if !streamedTokens && ev.Reply != "" {
					fmt.Fprintln(out, "  "+strings.ReplaceAll(FormatMarkdown(ev.Reply), "\n", "\n  "))
				} else if streamedTokens {
					fmt.Fprintln(out)
				}
			}
		})
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %serror: %v%s\n\n", ansiRed, err, ansiReset)
			continue
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(out)

		finalReply := strings.TrimSpace(replyBuf.String())
		history = append(history,
			llm.Message{Role: "user", Content: line},
			llm.Message{Role: "assistant", Content: finalReply},
		)
	}
}

func handleSlashCommand(
	ctx context.Context,
	line string,
	opts *Options,
	history *[]llm.Message,
	activePersona **agent.Persona,
	scanner *bufio.Scanner,
	out io.Writer,
) (bool, error) {
	fields := strings.Fields(line)
	cmd := strings.ToLower(fields[0])
	arg := ""
	if len(fields) > 1 {
		arg = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields[1:], " "))
	}

	switch cmd {
	case "/quit", "/exit", "/q":
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s  Until next time. Mímir remembers.%s\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
		return true, nil

	case "/help", "/?":
		fmt.Fprintf(out, `
%s  Mímir Slash Commands:%s
    %s/model [name]%s              Auto-discover local Ollama/LM Studio models or switch model
    %s/providers%s                 Show built-in BYOK providers + Mímir Well Subscription tiers
    %s/ingest [path|git-url]%s     GitIngest a repo/folder into digest + Yggdrasil Mind Map in Cortex
    %s/mindmap [query]%s           View the Yggdrasil Mind Map or ask Liquid d1-omni-600M for top files
    %s/mode [ro|edit|bypass]%s     Cycle or set permission mode (ro hides write tools from model!)
    %s/effort [off|low|med|high]%s Toggle reasoning/thinking budget (off = fast /no_think loops)
    %s/smol [auto|on|off]%s        Toggle SmolMode optimizations for compact/local models
    %s/decide [prompt]%s           Run Liquid AI d1-omni-600M System-One decision check on a prompt
    %s/persona [name]%s            Switch Norse persona (odin, thor, loki, heimdall, bragi, huginn, muninn, forseti)
    %s/swarm [add|list|run]%s      Manage Level 3 Multi-Agent Software Factory queue
    %s/todo%s                      Show the active harness-owned Todo checklist
    %s/handoff%s                   Generate .mimir/HANDOFF.md for session continuity
    %s/memory%s                    Show stored Cortex memories
    %s/compact%s                   Prune old file-write payloads from conversation history now
    %s/web%s                       Start or show the live Book-Spine Web UI URL
    %s/clear%s                     Clear current conversation history
    %s/quit%s                      Exit Mímir TUI
`+"\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, ansiReset,
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset,
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset,
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset,
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset,
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset,
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, ansiCyan, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/mode":
		var next string
		if arg == "" {
			next = opts.Agent.CycleMode()
		} else {
			switch strings.ToLower(arg) {
			case "ro", "readonly", "read-only":
				opts.Agent.SetMode(agent.ModeReadOnly)
			case "edit":
				opts.Agent.SetMode(agent.ModeEdit)
			case "bypass", "yolo":
				opts.Agent.SetMode(agent.ModeBypass)
			default:
				return false, fmt.Errorf("unknown mode %q (use ro, edit, or bypass)", arg)
			}
			next = opts.Agent.Mode()
		}
		toolCount := 0
		if opts.Tools != nil {
			toolCount = len(opts.Tools.ForMode(next))
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Mode -> %s%s (%d tools visible to model)\n\n", ansiGreen, next, ansiReset, toolCount)
		return false, nil

	case "/effort":
		switch strings.ToLower(arg) {
		case "off", "none":
			opts.Agent.SetEffort("off")
		case "low":
			opts.Agent.SetEffort("low")
		case "med", "medium":
			opts.Agent.SetEffort("medium")
		case "high":
			opts.Agent.SetEffort("high")
		case "auto", "default", "":
			if arg == "" {
				// Cycle: "" -> "off" -> "low" -> "medium" -> "high" -> ""
				switch opts.Agent.Effort() {
				case "":
					opts.Agent.SetEffort("off")
				case "off":
					opts.Agent.SetEffort("low")
				case "low":
					opts.Agent.SetEffort("medium")
				case "medium":
					opts.Agent.SetEffort("high")
				default:
					opts.Agent.SetEffort("")
				}
			} else {
				opts.Agent.SetEffort("")
			}
		default:
			return false, fmt.Errorf("unknown effort %q (use off, low, medium, high, or auto)", arg)
		}
		eff := opts.Agent.Effort()
		if eff == "" {
			eff = "auto"
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Reasoning effort -> %s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, eff, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/smol":
		switch strings.ToLower(arg) {
		case "on", "true", "1":
			opts.Agent.SetSmolPolicy(agent.SmolOn)
		case "off", "false", "0":
			opts.Agent.SetSmolPolicy(agent.SmolOff)
		default:
			opts.Agent.SetSmolPolicy(agent.SmolAuto)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ SmolMode policy -> %s (active=%v)%s\n\n",
			ansiGreen, opts.Agent.SmolPolicy(), opts.Agent.SmolMode(), ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/decide":
		dec := opts.Agent.Decider()
		if arg == "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s⚡ System-One Decision Engine: %s%s\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, dec.Model, ansiReset)
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sUsage: /decide <prompt or command> to inspect routing, tool pruning, Mind Map files, and safety score.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		route := dec.RoutePrompt(ctx, arg)
		safety := dec.AssessCommandSafety(ctx, arg)
		var toolNames []string
		if opts.Tools != nil {
			for _, t := range opts.Tools.ForMode(opts.Agent.Mode()) {
				toolNames = append(toolNames, t.Name())
			}
		}
		pruned := dec.PruneToolNames(ctx, arg, toolNames, 5)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n  %s⚡ Huginn-Decider (%s):%s\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, dec.Model, ansiReset)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• Route:%s Persona=%s (%s tier, thinking=%v, conf=%.0f%%)\n",
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, route.Persona, route.Tier, route.NeedsThinking, route.Confidence*100)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• Pruned Tools (top %d):%s %s\n",
			ansiCyan, len(pruned), ansiReset, strings.Join(pruned, ", "))
		if mm, ok := ingest.LatestMindMap(opts.Cortex); ok {
			var entries []string
			for _, n := range mm.Nodes {
				entries = append(entries, n.Path+" "+strings.Join(n.Symbols, " "))
			}
			topFiles := dec.SelectMindMapFiles(ctx, arg, entries, 4)
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• Yggdrasil Mind Map (%s):%s %s\n",
				ansiCyan, mm.RepoName, ansiReset, strings.Join(topFiles, " | "))
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• Safety Gate:%s score=%.2f (auto_approve=%v, %s)\n\n",
			ansiCyan, ansiReset, safety.SafeScore, safety.AutoApprove, safety.Reason)
		return false, nil

	case "/ingest", "/gitingest":
		src := arg
		if src == "" {
			src = "."
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s◈ Gjallarhorn-Ingest scanning %s...%s\n", ansiPurple, src, ansiReset)
		res, err := ingest.Run(ctx, ingest.Options{Source: src}, opts.Cortex)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Ingested %s (%d files, ~%dk tokens) -> %d Yggdrasil Mind Map neurons saved to Cortex%s\n\n",
			ansiGreen, res.MindMap.RepoName, res.MindMap.TotalFiles, res.MindMap.EstTokens/1000, res.NeuronsSaved, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/mindmap", "/map":
		mm, ok := ingest.LatestMindMap(opts.Cortex)
		if !ok {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sNo Yggdrasil Mind Map in Cortex yet. Run `/ingest .` or `/ingest <git-url>` first.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		if arg == "" {
			fmt.Fprintln(out, "\n"+ingest.FormatMindMapCompact(*mm, 25))
			return false, nil
		}
		dec := opts.Agent.Decider()
		var entries []string
		var testFiles []string
		for _, n := range mm.Nodes {
			entries = append(entries, n.Path+" ("+strings.Join(n.Symbols, ",")+")")
			if n.IsTest {
				testFiles = append(testFiles, n.Path)
			}
		}
		top := dec.SelectMindMapFiles(ctx, arg, entries, 5)
		tests := dec.SelectAffectedTests(ctx, top, testFiles, 3)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n  %s🌳 Yggdrasil Mind Map + Liquid AI d1-omni-600M (%s):%s\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, mm.RepoName, ansiReset)
		for _, f := range top {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• File:%s %s\n", ansiCyan, ansiReset, f)
		}
		if len(tests) > 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• Affected Tests:%s %s\n", ansiPurple, ansiReset, strings.Join(tests, ", "))
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(out)
		return false, nil

	case "/providers", "/subscribe":
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n%s  ╭─ Mímir Well Subscriptions & BYOK Provider Catalog ─────────────────╮%s\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, ansiReset)
		for _, sub := range config.BuiltinSubscriptionTiers() {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s│%s %s%s (%s)%s - %s\n",
				ansiGold, ansiReset, ansiCyan+ansiBold, sub.Name, sub.Price, ansiReset, sub.Description)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤%s\n", ansiGold, ansiReset)
		for _, p := range config.BuiltinProviders() {
			badge := ansiDim + "[BYOK]" + ansiReset
			switch p.BillingMode {
			case "subscription":
				badge = ansiGold + "[SUB]" + ansiReset
			case "local_free":
				badge = ansiGreen + "[LOCAL]" + ansiReset
			}
			status := ansiDim + "unset" + ansiReset
			if p.Configured {
				status = ansiGreen + "ready" + ansiReset
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s│%s %s %-28s default=%-22s (%s)\n",
				ansiGold, ansiReset, badge, p.Name, p.DefaultModel, status)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s  ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯%s\n\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/sdlc", "/phase":
		mgr := opts.Agent.SDLC()
		sub := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(arg))
		switch sub {
		case "":
			fmt.Fprintln(out, "\n"+mgr.FormatBoard()+"\n")
			return false, nil
		case "next", "advance":
			spec, err := mgr.Advance()
			if err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ SDLC advanced -> [%d/7] %s (Persona: %s | Deliverable: %s)%s\n\n",
				ansiGreen, spec.Step, spec.Title, spec.Persona, spec.Deliverable, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		case "signoff", "sign-off", "sign":
			spec := mgr.SignOff("")
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Signed off SDLC Step %d (%s - %s)%s\n\n",
				ansiGreen, spec.Step, spec.Title, spec.Deliverable, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		case "agile", "waterfall", "devops":
			if err := mgr.SetMethodology(sub); err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ SDLC methodology -> %s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, mgr.Methodology(), ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		default:
			spec, err := mgr.SetPhase(sub)
			if err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ SDLC phase -> [%d/7] %s (Persona: %s | Deliverable: %s)%s\n\n",
				ansiGreen, spec.Step, spec.Title, spec.Persona, spec.Deliverable, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}

	case "/review", "/ship":
		eng, err := runengine.New(".", nil, runengine.DefaultLimits())
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		eng.SDLC = opts.Agent.SDLC()
		if opts.Tools != nil {
			if t, ok := opts.Tools.Get("todo"); ok {
				if tt, ok := t.(*tools.TodoTool); ok && tt.Store != nil {
					eng.Todos = tt.Store
				}
			}
		}
		var rep runengine.GateReport
		if cmd == "/ship" {
			rep = eng.ShipGate(ctx, runengine.GateOptions{})
		} else {
			rep = eng.ReviewGate(ctx, runengine.GateOptions{})
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(out, "\n"+FormatMarkdown(rep.FormatMarkdown())+"\n")
		return false, nil

	case "/audit-web", "/webaudit":
		target := arg
		if target == "" {
			target = "."
		}
		rep, err := tools.AuditWebDirectory(target)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(out, "\n"+FormatMarkdown(rep.FormatMarkdown())+"\n")
		return false, nil

	case "/swarm", "/factory":
		f := swarm.NewFactory(swarm.FactoryConfig{
			RootDir:      ".",
			MaxWorkers:   4,
			TargetBranch: "main",
		})
		parts := strings.Fields(arg)
		sub := ""
		if len(parts) > 0 {
			sub = strings.ToLower(parts[0])
		}
		switch sub {
		case "", "status", "list":
			fmt.Fprintln(out, "\n"+f.FormatStatus()+"\n")
		case "add", "submit":
			title := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(arg, sub))
			if title == "" {
				fmt.Fprintln(out, "  usage: /swarm add <title>")
				return false, nil
			}
			t, err := f.Submit(title, "Queued from interactive TUI.")
			if err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Submitted task %s (`%s`) -> branch: %s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, t.ID, t.Title, t.Branch, ansiReset)
		case "run":
			if len(parts) < 2 {
				fmt.Fprintln(out, "  usage: /swarm run <task-id>")
				return false, nil
			}
			taskID := parts[1]
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s▸ Starting autonomous pipeline for %s...%s\n", ansiCyan, taskID, ansiReset)
			if err := f.ExecuteTask(ctx, taskID); err != nil {
				return false, fmt.Errorf("swarm run: %w", err)
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Task %s completed successfully through Odin -> Thor -> Loki -> Heimdall pipeline!%s\n\n", ansiGreen, taskID, ansiReset)
		default:
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  unknown swarm action %q (try: list, add, run)\n", sub)
		}
		return false, nil

	case "/model", "/models":
		discovered := config.DiscoverLocalModels(ctx, 500*time.Millisecond)
		if arg != "" {
			// Direct switch by index or model name
			if idx, err := strconv.Atoi(arg); err == nil && idx >= 1 && idx <= len(discovered) {
				m := discovered[idx-1]
				prov := &llm.OpenAIProvider{IDStr: m.ProviderID, BaseURL: m.BaseURL, APIKey: m.APIKey, Model: m.Model}
				opts.Agent.SetProvider(prov, m.Model, m.Local)
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Switched to %s/%s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, m.ProviderID, m.Model, ansiReset)
				return false, nil
			}
			for _, m := range discovered {
				if strings.EqualFold(m.Model, arg) {
					prov := &llm.OpenAIProvider{IDStr: m.ProviderID, BaseURL: m.BaseURL, APIKey: m.APIKey, Model: m.Model}
					opts.Agent.SetProvider(prov, m.Model, m.Local)
					fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Switched to %s/%s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, m.ProviderID, m.Model, ansiReset)
					return false, nil
				}
			}
			// Keep current provider base URL and swap model name
			if ep, ok := config.AutoDiscoverProvider(ctx); ok {
				prov := &llm.OpenAIProvider{IDStr: ep.ID, BaseURL: ep.BaseURL, APIKey: ep.APIKey, Model: arg}
				local := strings.Contains(ep.BaseURL, "localhost") || strings.Contains(ep.BaseURL, "127.0.0.1")
				opts.Agent.SetProvider(prov, arg, local)
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Switched model to %s (%s)%s\n\n", ansiGreen, arg, ep.ID, ansiReset)
				return false, nil
			}
		}

		if len(discovered) == 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sNo local Ollama (:11434) or LM Studio (:1234) models detected.%s\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sTip: run `/model <model-id>` to switch models on your configured provider.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n%s  Discovered Local Models:%s\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, ansiReset)
		for i, m := range discovered {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s[%d]%s %s/%s %s(%s)%s\n",
				ansiCyan+ansiBold, i+1, ansiReset, m.ProviderID, m.Model, ansiDim, m.BaseURL, ansiReset)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sSelect number (1-%d) or Enter to cancel:%s ", ansiDim, len(discovered), ansiReset)
		if scanner.Scan() {
			choice := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
			if n, err := strconv.Atoi(choice); err == nil && n >= 1 && n <= len(discovered) {
				m := discovered[n-1]
				prov := &llm.OpenAIProvider{IDStr: m.ProviderID, BaseURL: m.BaseURL, APIKey: m.APIKey, Model: m.Model}
				opts.Agent.SetProvider(prov, m.Model, m.Local)
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Switched to %s/%s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, m.ProviderID, m.Model, ansiReset)
			}
		}
		return false, nil

	case "/todo", "/checklist":
		if opts.Tools == nil {
			return false, nil
		}
		t, ok := opts.Tools.Get("todo")
		if !ok {
			return false, nil
		}
		tt, ok := t.(*tools.TodoTool)
		if !ok || tt.Store == nil {
			return false, nil
		}
		items := tt.Store.List()
		if len(items) == 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sTodo checklist is empty.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n%s  ╭─ Harness Todo Checklist ───────────────────────────╮%s\n", ansiGold, ansiReset)
		for _, item := range items {
			badge := "[ ]"
			col := ansiDim
			switch item.Status {
			case tools.TodoCompleted:
				badge = "[✓]"
				col = ansiGreen
			case tools.TodoInProgress:
				badge = "[▸]"
				col = ansiCyan
			case tools.TodoBlocked:
				badge = "[!]"
				col = ansiRed
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s│%s %s%s #%d %s%s\n", ansiGold, ansiReset, col, badge, item.ID, item.Content, ansiReset)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s  ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯%s\n\n", ansiGold, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/handoff":
		var todos []string
		if opts.Tools != nil {
			if t, ok := opts.Tools.Get("todo"); ok {
				if tt, ok := t.(*tools.TodoTool); ok && tt.Store != nil {
					for _, item := range tt.Store.List() {
						todos = append(todos, fmt.Sprintf("- #%d [%s] %s", item.ID, item.Status, item.Content))
					}
				}
			}
		}
		summary := ""
		if mm, ok := ingest.LatestMindMap(opts.Cortex); ok {
			summary = fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d files, ~%dk tokens)", mm.RepoName, mm.TotalFiles, mm.EstTokens/1000)
		}
		sid := "tui-session"
		md := agent.GenerateHandoffMarkdown(sid, *history, todos, summary)
		outPath, err := agent.WriteHandoffFile(".", md)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Handoff generated at: %s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, outPath, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/pair":
		// The pairing session must live in the RUNNING server's relay
		// manager, exactly like the CLI pair flow (FIX 5): the old code
		// minted one in a throwaway in-process relay.Manager, so the QR
		// it printed could never complete pairing against the server.
		base := "http://127.0.0.1:8420"
		if opts.WebURL != "" {
			base = strings.TrimSuffix(opts.WebURL, "/app")
			base = strings.TrimRight(base, "/")
		}
		payload, err := fetchPairingPayload(base)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sPairing needs the Mimir server: could not reach %s (%v).%s\n", ansiRed, base, err, ansiReset)
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sStart it with /web (or run `mimir serve` in another terminal), then try /pair again.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n%s  === Mímir Mobile Companion Pairing (Happy E2EE) ===%s\n", ansiGold+ansiBold, ansiReset)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sSession ID:%s %s\n", ansiCyan, ansiReset, payload.Session.ID)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sPairing URI:%s %s\n\n", ansiCyan, ansiReset, payload.PairURI)
		fmt.Fprintln(out, payload.ASCIIQR)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sScan this QR code with the Mímir Flutter Mobile App to pair.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/memory", "/cortex":
		if opts.Cortex == nil {
			return false, nil
		}
		neurons := opts.Cortex.All()
		if len(neurons) == 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sNo neurons stored in Cortex yet.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n%s  Cortex Memories (%d):%s\n", ansiPurple+ansiBold, len(neurons), ansiReset)
		for i, n := range neurons {
			if i >= 15 {
				fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s... and %d more%s\n", ansiDim, len(neurons)-15, ansiReset)
				break
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %s• [%s]%s %s\n", ansiPurple, n.Kind, ansiReset, truncate(n.Content, 80))
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(out)
		return false, nil

	case "/persona":
		if arg == "" || arg == "clear" || arg == "off" {
			*activePersona = nil
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sCleared persona (using default Mímir voice).%s\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
			var names []string
			for _, p := range agent.BuiltinPersonas {
				names = append(names, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", p.Name, p.Role))
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sAvailable: %s%s\n\n", ansiDim, strings.Join(names, ", "), ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		p, ok := agent.PersonaByName(strings.ToLower(arg))
		if !ok {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("unknown persona %q", arg)
		}
		*activePersona = &p
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Persona active: %s (%s)%s\n\n", ansiGreen, p.Name, p.Role, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/compact":
		before := agent.EstimateTokens(*history)
		*history = agent.PruneHistoryPlaceholders(*history, 2)
		after := agent.EstimateTokens(*history)
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ History compacted (%d -> %d est. tokens)%s\n\n", ansiGreen, before, after, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/web":
		if opts.WebURL != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s● Book-Spine Web UI is live at %s%s\n\n", ansiGold, opts.WebURL, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		if opts.StartWebFn != nil {
			url, err := opts.StartWebFn()
			if err != nil {
				return false, err
			}
			opts.WebURL = url
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Started Book-Spine Web UI at %s%s\n\n", ansiGreen, url, ansiReset)
			return false, nil
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %sRun `mimir --web` or `mimir serve` to enable the Web UI.%s\n\n", ansiDim, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	case "/clear":
		*history = nil
		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s✓ Conversation history cleared.%s\n\n", ansiGreen, ansiReset)
		return false, nil

	default:
		return false, fmt.Errorf("unknown command %q (type /help for commands)", cmd)
	}
}

// pairingPayload mirrors the JSON returned by the server's /api/pair
// endpoint (same shape the CLI pair flow consumes).
type pairingPayload struct {
	Session struct {
		ID string `json:"id"`
	} `json:"session"`
	PairURI string `json:"pair_uri"`
	ASCIIQR string `json:"ascii_qr"`
}

// fetchPairingPayload asks the running server to create a pairing session
// in its own relay manager and returns the QR payload it responds with.
// The session has to live server-side: the phone completes pairing
// against the server, so a session minted in this process could never
// be paired with.
func fetchPairingPayload(base string) (*pairingPayload, error) {
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
	resp, err := client.Get(base + "/api/pair")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("server returned %s", resp.Status)
	}
	var payload pairingPayload
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if payload.PairURI == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("server returned an empty pairing payload")
	}
	return &payload, nil
}

package tui

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/agent"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/cortex"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/llm"
	"github.com/David2024patton/Mimir/internal/tools"
)

type fakeTUIProvider struct{}

func (f *fakeTUIProvider) ID() string { return "ollama" }
func (f *fakeTUIProvider) Generate(context.Context, llm.GenerateRequest) (llm.GenerateResponse, error) {
	return llm.GenerateResponse{Content: "Skål from Mímir!", FinishReason: "stop"}, nil
}
func (f *fakeTUIProvider) Stream(context.Context, llm.GenerateRequest) (<-chan llm.StreamEvent, error) {
	ch := make(chan llm.StreamEvent, 2)
	ch <- llm.StreamEvent{Delta: "Skål from Mímir!"}
	ch <- llm.StreamEvent{Done: true, Usage: llm.Usage{PromptTokens: 12, CompletionTokens: 5}}
	close(ch)
	return ch, nil
}

func TestTUISlashCommandsAndChatTurn(t *testing.T) {
	store, err := cortex.NewMemoryStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "cortex.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store: %v", err)
	}
	reg := tools.Default(t.TempDir())
	tracker := llm.NewTracker()
	ag := agent.New(agent.Config{
		Provider: &fakeTUIProvider{},
		Tools:    reg,
		Cortex:   store,
		Model:    "qwen3:8b",
		Usage:    tracker,
		Local:    true,
	})

	input := strings.Join([]string{
		"/mode ro",
		"/effort off",
		"/decide refactor the polyglot architecture",
		"/persona odin",
		"hello mimir",
		"/quit",
	}, "\n") + "\n"

	var out bytes.Buffer
	err = Run(context.Background(), Options{
		Version:   "0.2.0-test",
		Agent:     ag,
		Tools:     reg,
		Cortex:    store,
		Usage:     tracker,
		StoreDesc: "file-backed test",
		In:        strings.NewReader(input),
		Out:       &out,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("TUI Run failed: %v", err)
	}

	got := out.String()
	for _, want := range []string{
		"Mímir 0.2.0-test",
		"Mode -> ro",
		"Reasoning effort -> off",
		"Huginn-Decider (liquid/d1-omni-600m)",
		"Persona=Odin",
		"Persona active: odin",
		"Skål from Mímir!",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(got, want) {
			t.Errorf("TUI output missing %q.\nFull output:\n%s", want, got)
		}
	}
}

func TestPromptQuestionsSelector(t *testing.T) {
	qs := []tools.Question{
		{
			Header:   "Database",
			Question: "Which Cortex backend do you want?",
			Options: []tools.Option{
				{Label: "File JSON", Description: "Zero-setup local file"},
				{Label: "SurrealDB", Description: "Hybrid vector + FTS"},
			},
		},
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	ans, err := PromptQuestions(context.Background(), strings.NewReader("2\n"), &out, qs)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PromptQuestions failed: %v", err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(ans, "Database: SurrealDB") {
		t.Errorf("got answer %q, want 'Database: SurrealDB'", ans)
	}
}

# publish-engines.ps1 -- rebuild Alpha Flux LLC engine binaries from their source
# branches and refresh engines/bin/manifest.json on main.
#
# Usage (from the repo root, on main):
#   .\scripts\publish-engines.ps1                 # build all engines
#   .\scripts\publish-engines.ps1 -Only tyr       # build one engine
#   .\scripts\publish-engines.ps1 -Commit         # also commit + push main
#
# Each engine is built in a throwaway git worktree so main's working tree never
# contains engine source. Users then pick up the new binaries with `mimir update`.

param(
    [string]$Only = "",
    [switch]$Commit
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim()
Set-Location $root

$branch = (git branch --show-current).Trim()
if ($branch -ne "main") { throw "Run this from main (currently on '$branch')." }

$engines = @(
    @{ Key = "tyr";       Branch = "engine/tyr-rust";       Pkg = "./cmd/tyr-engine";       Out = "mimir_tyr_engine.exe" },
    @{ Key = "mjolnir";   Branch = "engine/mjolnir-mojo";   Pkg = "./cmd/mjolnir-engine";   Out = "mimir_mjolnir_engine.exe" },
    @{ Key = "alphaflux"; Branch = "engine/alphaflux-core"; Pkg = "./cmd/alphaflux-engine"; Out = "mimir_alphaflux_engine.exe" }
)

$binDir = Join-Path $root "engines\bin"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $binDir | Out-Null
$wtBase = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "mimir-engine-build"

$targets = @(
    @{ OS = "windows"; Arch = "amd64"; Suffix = "_windows_amd64.exe" },
    @{ OS = "linux";   Arch = "amd64"; Suffix = "_linux_amd64" },
    @{ OS = "darwin";  Arch = "arm64"; Suffix = "_darwin_arm64" }
)

foreach ($e in $engines) {
    if ($Only -and $e.Key -ne $Only) { continue }
    $wt = Join-Path $wtBase $e.Key
    if (Test-Path $wt) { git worktree remove --force $wt | Out-Null }
    Write-Host "checking out $($e.Branch) into worktree"
    git worktree add --detach $wt $e.Branch | Out-Null
    try {
        Push-Location $wt
        # 1. Compile host binary
        Write-Host "  -> building host binary $($e.Out)"
        go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o (Join-Path $binDir $e.Out) $e.Pkg
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "host build failed for $($e.Branch)" }

        # 2. Compile cross-platform matrix
        $baseName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($e.Out)
        foreach ($t in $targets) {
            $crossOut = "$baseName$($t.Suffix)"
            Write-Host "  -> building cross-platform binary $crossOut ($($t.OS)/$($t.Arch))"
            $env:GOOS = $t.OS
            $env:GOARCH = $t.Arch
            $env:CGO_ENABLED = "0"
            go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o (Join-Path $binDir $crossOut) $e.Pkg
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "cross-build failed for $($e.Branch) ($($t.OS)/$($t.Arch))" }
        }
        $env:GOOS = ""
        $env:GOARCH = ""
    } finally {
        $env:GOOS = ""
        $env:GOARCH = ""
        Pop-Location
        git worktree remove --force $wt | Out-Null
    }
}

go build -o bin\mimir.exe ./cmd/mimir
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "harness build failed" }
.\bin\mimir.exe engines publish
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "manifest publish failed" }

if ($Commit) {
    git add engines/bin
    git commit -m "chore(engines): publish rebuilt Alpha Flux LLC engine binaries"
    git push origin main
}

# Serves the landing page + app mockup. Run on a 5-digit port (never 8080):

# Then open http://localhost:47312/app-mockup.html
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY index.html app-mockup.html /usr/share/nginx/html/
EXPOSE 80

function setAccent(el,c,cd){ document.querySelectorAll('.swatch').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active')); el.classList.add('active'); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--teal',c); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--teal-d',cd); }
/* status reactor */
const statuses=[{l:'building',c:'#2dd4bf'},{l:'task done',c:'#f87171'},{l:'final answer',c:'#fbbf24'},{l:'error',c:'#ef4444'},{l:'waiting for you',c:'#f59e0b'}];
let statusIdx=0;

/* thinking / mode / think level */
function toggleThink(el){ el.parentElement.classList.toggle('collapsed'); }
function setMode(el){ document.querySelectorAll('.mt').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active')); el.classList.add('active'); toast(el.textContent==='Plan' ? '<b>Plan mode</b>: Mímir will only plan, not build.' : '<b>Build mode</b>: Mímir will write code.'); }

function renderSpines(){
  document.getElementById('spines').innerHTML=spineDefs.map(s=>
    `<div class="spine ${openPanels.includes(s.id)?'open':''}" onclick="togglePanel('${s.id}')" title="${s.label}">${s.label}</div>`).join('');
}
function renderPanels(){
  const el=document.getElementById('panels');
  el.innerHTML=openPanels.map(id=>{
    const def=spineDefs.find(s=>s.id===id);
    return `<div class="panel" data-id="${id}" ondragover="panelDragOver(event,this)" ondrop="panelDrop(event,this)" ondragleave="this.classList.remove('drag-over')">
      <div class="panel-h" draggable="true" ondragstart="panelDragStart(event,'${id}')"><span class="grip">⋮⋮</span><span class="ptitle">${def.label}</span><span class="pclose" onclick="closePanel('${id}')" onmousedown="event.stopPropagation()">✕</span></div>
      <div class="panel-b">${panelContent[id]()}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function togglePanel(id){
  const i=openPanels.indexOf(id);
  if(i>=0){ openPanels.splice(i,1); }
  else{ openPanels.push(id); if(openPanels.length>2) openPanels.shift(); }
  renderSpines(); renderPanels();
}
function closePanel(id){ openPanels=openPanels.filter(x=>x!==id); renderSpines(); renderPanels(); }
function panelDragStart(e,id){ e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',id); e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move'; }
function panelDragOver(e,el){ e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='move'; el.classList.add('drag-over'); }
function panelDrop(e,el){ e.preventDefault(); el.classList.remove('drag-over');
  const from=e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'), to=el.dataset.id;
  if(from&&to&&from!==to){ const fi=openPanels.indexOf(from), ti=openPanels.indexOf(to);
    if(fi>=0&&ti>=0){ openPanels.splice(ti,0,openPanels.splice(fi,1)[0]); renderPanels(); toast('Moved <b>'+def_label(from)+'</b> panel'); } } }
function def_label(id){ const d=spineDefs.find(s=>s.id===id); return d?d.label:id; }
renderSpines(); renderPanels();

/* approve checkpoint */
document.getElementById('approveBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  document.getElementById('gate').innerHTML='<div class="gt" style="color:var(--lime)">Checkpoint cleared</div><p style="margin:0">Design approved. Research, Plan, then Build.</p>';
  document.getElementById('buildMsg').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('flowPlan').className='flow-step done'; document.getElementById('flowPlan').querySelector('.fdot').textContent='✓';
  document.getElementById('flowBuild').className='flow-step current';
  const tp=document.getElementById('twPlan'); tp.className='tw-row done'; tp.querySelector('.b').textContent='✓';
  const ts=document.getElementById('twS1'); ts.className='tw-row active'; ts.querySelector('.b').textContent='▶';
  document.getElementById('taskPill').textContent='Task 5 of 8 · next: S1 Debug';
  openPanels=['code','preview']; renderSpines(); renderPanels();
  document.getElementById('chatBody').scrollTop=document.getElementById('chatBody').scrollHeight;
  toast('<b>Thor</b> is building Task 5 of 8 · Loki debugs, Forseti audits, Heimdall screenshots');
});
</script>

    <div class="prow"><span class="glyph" style="background:var(--red)">F</span><div><div class="nm">Forseti</div><div class="rl">code auditor</div></div><div class="ds">The judge. Reviews every line for quality, correctness, and security before it ships.</div></div>

<!-- FEATURES - bento -->
<section id="features" style="background:var(--ink2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="rv"><div class="eyebrow">What it does</div>
  <h2>Built to be <em>the whole shop</em>.</h2>
  <p class="sub">Not just an autocomplete. A framework that plans, builds, tests, deploys,
    remembers, and gets smarter.</p></div>
  <div class="bento">
    <div class="bcard b7 rv"><span class="tag t-teal">memory</span><span class="ic">🧠</span><h3>The Cortex - a brain that grows</h3><p>A neural knowledge graph (neurons, synapses, engrams) on SurrealDB. Every correction becomes a lesson, every lesson becomes memory. Multilingual embeddings, RAG with citations, a forgetting curve that keeps it sharp.</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b5 rv"><span class="tag t-ember">autonomy</span><span class="ic">🎯</span><h3>Goal mode</h3><p>Tell it the end goal. It plans, builds, tests, and doesn't stop until it's done - with checkpoints so you stay in control.</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b4 rv"><span class="tag t-blue">any model</span><span class="ic">⚡</span><h3>Your models, your call</h3><p>Any provider - OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter - or fully local with Ollama. Small models welcome.</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b4 rv"><span class="tag t-gold">sandbox</span><span class="ic">🐳</span><h3>Docker-first</h3><p>Every project gets a Dockerfile. Databases, previews on real ports, deployed anywhere - never "works on my machine."</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b4 rv"><span class="tag t-lime">open</span><span class="ic">🧩</span><h3>WASM modules</h3><p>Build modules in any language - Rust, C, Go, whatever. They compile to WebAssembly and just work, safely sandboxed.</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b5 rv"><span class="tag t-teal">verify</span><span class="ic">🛡️</span><h3>Three auditors, every step</h3><p>Loki tests it, Forseti audits the code, Heimdall screenshots the UI. If anything fails, it loops back and fixes it - it never moves on broken.</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b7 rv"><span class="tag t-ember">alive</span><span class="ic">💡</span><h3>It lights up your room</h3><p>Task done? Your Corsair keyboard pulses red. Final answer? A gold sweep. Mímir syncs its status to your RGB gear, and the UI glows with it. Futuristic, vibrant, alive.</p></div>
    <div class="bcard b12 rv"><span class="tag t-blue">everything else</span><span class="ic">∞</span><h3>And the rest of the shop: git commits that explain themselves · visual regression testing · CI/CD that reviews your PRs · a marketplace of forkable experiments · voice in and out · offline and air-gapped · real-time collaboration · a dashboard that counts every token</h3><p style="margin-top:8px">Seventy-one planned features across 88 epics - see the plan on GitHub.</p></div>

/* scroll reveal */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

/* hero: live agent simulation, looping */
const script=[
  {who:'odin',name:'odin',txt:'hey, before i build anything - quick question. what kind of app is this?'},
  {who:'you',name:'you',txt:'a task-tracker. clean, minimal, no logins.'},
  {who:'odin',name:'odin',txt:'bet. docs are done, split it into 8 tasks. mocked the UI for you to check.'},
  {gate:true},
  {who:'thor',name:'thor',txt:'design approved. building task 5 of 8: layout + header.'},
  {who:'heim',name:'heimdall',txt:'screenshot looks right. loki tested it, forseti signed off. committed.'},
];
const body=document.getElementById('simBody'), gate=document.getElementById('simGate'), flows=document.querySelectorAll('#simFlow .sf');
let si=0;
function setFlow(n){flows.forEach(f=>{const i=+f.dataset.i;f.className='sf'+(i<n?' done':(i===n?' on':''))})}
function typeLine(item,done){
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='sline';
  if(item.gate){gate.classList.add('show');setTimeout(done,1400);return}
  d.innerHTML='<span class="who '+item.who+'">'+item.name+' ›</span> <span class="txt"></span><span class="caret"></span>';
  body.appendChild(d);body.scrollTop=body.scrollHeight;
  const t=d.querySelector('.txt');let i=0;
  const iv=setInterval(()=>{t.textContent=item.txt.slice(0,++i);body.scrollTop=body.scrollHeight;
    if(i>=item.txt.length){clearInterval(iv);d.querySelector('.caret').remove();setTimeout(done,500)}},14);
}
function step(){
  if(si>=script.length){setTimeout(()=>{body.innerHTML='';gate.classList.remove('show');si=0;setFlow(0);step()},2600);return}
  const item=script[si];setFlow(Math.min(si,6));typeLine(item,()=>{si++;setTimeout(step,300)});
}
step();

/* duplicate ticker for seamless loop */
document.getElementById('tick').innerHTML+=document.getElementById('tick').innerHTML;
</script>
</body>

@echo off
setlocal
rem ============================================================
rem  Mímir launcher - type anything, no env-var setup needed.
rem  Defaults to LOCAL Ollama (free, no API key, your machine).
rem
rem  Examples:
rem    test-mimir                       show status (tools + provider)
rem    test-mimir "explain this repo"   one chat turn
rem    test-mimir trace "list the files here with bash, then reply DONE"
rem
rem  To use a CLOUD provider instead (e.g. your Qwen token plan), set these
rem  BEFORE running this file:
rem    set MIMIR_BASE_URL=https://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
rem    set MIMIR_API_KEY=your-sk-sp-...-key
rem    set MIMIR_MODEL=qwen3.6-flash
rem ============================================================
if not defined MIMIR_BASE_URL set MIMIR_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1
if not defined MIMIR_MODEL    set MIMIR_MODEL=qwen3:8b
"%~dp0bin\mimir.exe" %*
endlocal
